tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bla ma gong ma'i gsung bgros zab mo rnams bsgrigs pa'i bar ston zin bris su grags pa'i gsung rab nas shin tu zab pa'i gsung bgros kyi gnad rnams logs su bkol pa sgrub pa po rnams kyi yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /maṅga laṃ// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal bzang rnams kyis mthong na nyams rtogs kyi/ /'bras bu 'bad med 'byung bar byed pa yi/ /gong ma'i gsung bgros bdud rtsi'i zegs ma rnams/ /zab gnad bsdus te bdag gis 'dir spel lo/ /deng sang dus kyi skye bo skal ngan rnams/ /gong ma'i gsung rab bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin 'dor/ /tshul 'di ma bzod lhag bsam dag pa yis/ /legs bshad 'di la mkha' 'gros gnang bar mdzod/ /lam 'bras nyams su len pa'i sngags 'chang rnams/ /lam 'bras gnad kyi gsung bgros 'di ltos la/ /lam 'bras chos kyi rang gzhan don sgrub ste/ /lam 'bras thos pa don ldan bya bar rigs/ /zhes gdams nas de la 'dir lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bla ma gong ma'i gsung bgros zab mo rnams bsgrigs pa'i bar ston zin bris su grags pa'i gsung rab nas shin tu zab pa'i gsung bgros kyi gnad rnams logs su bkol ba sgrub pa po rnams kyi yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di bshad par bya'o/ /de yang rgyud gdams ngag sogs nyan pa'i dus su bla ma la slob ma so sos phyag gsum byas/ me tog bla ma'i phyag tu phul/ lus 'dud pa dang bcas pas gral la 'khod de maṇ+ḍal rgyas par phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyi/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs/

/khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /ces pa de 'dra lan gsum bya'o/ /de rnams slob ma'i bya ba'o/ /de nas bla mas 'di bzhin du bya ste/ rgyud sde'am/ gdams ngag lta bu'i nyan bshad kyi sngon du phyag dang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di bzhin byed dgos pa de yang / chos rje'i zhal nas slob dpon gyi che thabs tshol ba lta bu'am/ go blo lta bu zhig min/ sangs rgyas rang gis rgyud sde nas bya bar gsungs te/ gur las/ gang gis slob dpon gsol ma btab/ /'dir ni rigs su skyes pa med/ /ces dang / bla ma lnga bcu par/ snyim pa me tog bcas thal mos/ /nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab/ /ces gsungs pas/ de'i phyag len bzhin bla ma gong ma rnams mdzad pas 'o skol yang de'i phyag len ma nyams tsam byed pa yin zhes bya'o/ /'di yan chad du dmigs bsal ma byung pa rnams tshogs bsgom pa'i gsung bgros su go bar bya lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag gi bla ma bzhi'i skabs su/ slob ma'i sbyang gzhi lus rtsa la zer kyang / ma dag pa rten khog pa'ang / phra ba rtsa phran stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis la sogs pa la smin byed bum dbang bskur nas sprul sku'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa la phyi'i bla ma zer gsungs/ dbang gong ma gsum la'ang des 'gre /'dir chos rje pa'i gsung gis/ spyir chos kyi 'du sa che sa gcig tu go na thams cad go yong ste 'dir yang bla ma bzhi'i skabs 'dir go na/ de man chad bklags pas shes gsungs/ yang bla ma bzhi'ang rten 'brel lngar 'du ste/ phyi'i bla ma ni phyi rten 'brel nas/ mthar thug bla ma ni mthar thug dang / de kho na nyid rten 'brel zhes pa'i bar du dang / gzhan gdams ngag drug la sogs pa la'ang sbyar du nyan gsungs/ 'o na phyi nang sogs 'di rnams bla ma la ming 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zer na/

dper na lo zhing thog nas legs kyang / khyim bdag che ge mo lo legs zer ba bzhin no/ /dam pa'i skabs su sbyang gzhi'i steng du sngar bzhin sku bzhi'i rten 'brel bsgrig mkhyen pa de ka la bla ma yang yin la dam pa yang yin pas gzhi mthun no/ /btud de zhes pa sngon byung bdag med ma'i zhabs la bir+wa pas/ da lta 'chad nyan byed pos btud pa'o/ /btud nas ci byed na/ dper na lag pa bkrus nas ci byed/ zan byed zer ba ltar bri bar bya/ gang 'dri na lam 'bras so/ /de la gsum/ /lam dang 'bras bu tshogs pa'am/ sdom pa'i dmigs don no/ /ye shes 'jug ldog skabs su/ dper na chu 'khyags pa 'khyag rom du song pa ltar te/ chu bya ba reg bya shin tu sla ba de dgun grang ba'i reg bya dang 'phrad pas chab rom zer ba rdo ba bas kyang sra ba gcig tu 'gro /de bzhin du snang snang gi dngos po 'di rnams bden dngos su ma grub pa chu sla ba dang 'dra ba ste/ 'jig rten pa'i dus su grang reg lta bu'i bden 'dzin brtags pas/ dgra gnyen sogs blang dor sna tshogs tha dad du 'dzin pa'o/ /'das pa'i dus su sos ka chab rom zhu ba ltar rnam rtog skye ba ltar byed kyang / de ma thag mi rtog pa'i chur 'gro gsungs/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa ni/ lam dus su 'bras bu'i chos rnams tshang rung du bsgom pa ste/ dper na bskyed rim gyi mngon byang lnga'i dang po me long lta bu'i ye shes bsgom pa la sogs sam/ rdzogs rim la rten dkyil 'khor bzhi sku bzhir bsgom pa bsam pas shes gsungs/ sde snod gsum gyi de nyid kyi skabs su/ rje pa'i gsung gis/ sde snod nas kyang / ting nge 'dzin/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ phan yon/ bar chad bsal lugs/ sa mtshams rnams gsungs/ 'di nas kyang de rnams ston pa yin/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig lta bu yin te/ de'i don gzhung 'di bla ma'i man ngag yod na go zhing 'brel chags/ man ngag med par spar tshod kyis mi go zhing ma 'brel ba lta bu ste/

dper na dus 'khor gyi me lag pa sogs kyi brda bzhin gsungs so/ /nor bu rin po che lta bu'i dpe sgyus na/ don rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo lta bu'i rdo rje'i lus skyon med cig la/ nor bu rin po che lta bu'i gdams ngag 'di btags te/ 'dod 'dun drag pos gsol ba 'debs pa bzhin brtson 'grus chen pos bsgrubs na/ gnas skabs kyi dgos 'dod 'byung pa bzhin/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan gyi sangs rgyas 'byung bas so/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las mang nyung med na tshig rkang bkar thal ba'i skyon yod pas gsung mdo sde de bri bar bya ba'i dus kyi khyad par sa ga'i nyi shu gnyis kyi nub mo/ /byin rlabs kyi khyad par snyan brgyud bzhi'i byin gyis rlabs nas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi mnyam bzhag tu ji ltar rtogs pa de rjes thob tu thugs rje chen pos kun nas bslangs nas gzhan don du bri bar bya/ de'ang sngon byung dang rjes 'jug gi don du gsung mdo'i tshul du ste/ rgyud sde rnams las rgya cher gsungs pas na gsungs/ mdo zhes pa tshig mdor bsdus la don rgyas pa'i tshul gyis bri bar bya zhes gsungs so// ༈ //rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig nyid 'chad pa la/ chos rje ba'i zhal nas gzhung chen mo 'chad pa bzhin/ dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ mtshams sbyar/ brgal lan dang / dgos 'brel sogs sbyar te bshad du nyan mod kyang / sa bcad bsdus nas byed pa 'di man ngag pa'i lugs yin gsungs/ lam zab 'bring gsum gyi skabs su/ dbang po rab bla ma la mos gus gyis lam bgrod pa yin te 'og tu ston/ 'bring dam tshig nyi shu la bsrung tshul lngas bsrung ba'ang 'og tu/ tha ma lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa rten 'brel lnga'i lam bya ba/ rten 'brel yang lus la/ spang bya yang lus kyis sa lam yang lus la bgrod pa yin te/ gzhung 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo yin gsungs/ snang ba gsum la ma dag pa'i snang ba ni/

nyon mongs med na ma tha dmyal ba dang / ya tha paṇ+ḍi ta'i bar gyi snang ba thams cad ma dag pa'i snang ba yin gsungs/ thos bsam gyi dag pa ni/ bka' bstan bcos/ rgyud man ngag sogs thos bsam gyi mtha' legs par chod pa zhig gal che/ de'i steng du sor thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa rnam dag cig gsang sngags kyi lam rten du dgos kyi/ sngags la zhugs pas 'og ma'i bcas pa g.yel du song na gnad ma go gsungs/ dbang gi dag pa'ang / bka' yod la lhad ma zhugs pa zhig la dbang bzhi legs par thob dgos kyi ci thod thod kyis go mi chod gsungs/ rnam rtog sngon song gis ni kun gzhi la rnam rtog gi bzo byas nas bag chags bzhag pa zhig yin te/ dper na mgo na ru 'ong snyam pa'am/ nga la dpe dkar zhig gnod du 'ong snyam pa yang yang bsams pas na ba dang gnod pa bzhin du nga la zung 'jug gi nyams bzang po zhig cis kyang skye 'ong snyam du yang nas yang du bsgoms pas skye ba yin gsungs/ rje'i zhal nas/ kha nang du log nas sgom gcig byed na/ sde snod gsum kha bton du 'don shes pa bas kyang / nyams bco lnga po 'di shes pa gdams gsungs pa la/ chos rje ba na re/ de shes pa la yang sde snod shes dgos par gda' gsungs/ sku'i gsang ba ni/ byang sems shugs 'chang gis/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu'i gtsug tor lta bar 'dod nas/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi nas tshangs pa'i lo ka'i bar du phyin pas kyang ma mthong pa bzhin no/ /gsung gi gsang ba ni/ mau mgal bus gsung gi mtha' brtag pa'i don du sangs rgyas kyi 'khor rgya mtsho lta bu'i mthar phyin pas kyang sngar bzhin thos/ de nas phyi lcags ri nag po'i steng du phyin pas kyang sngar bzhin/ de nas nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dpag med 'das pa'i pha rol tu 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i zhing na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba la 'khor nyan thos gzugs byad phun sum tshogs pa 'dug pa'i lhung bzed kyi lcug 'khor la zer 'khor mas 'dzegs pas ri chen po'i ltos la 'dzegs pa tsam byung /

der khong rnams kyis lag khud du bzhag nas 'di 'dra ba'i chung pa la dge sbyong gi gzugs can/ chos gos ni gyon lhung bzed ni thogs pa mdzes zer gyin srog chags phra mo la byed pa bzhin brnyas pas de bzhin gshegs pa na re/ 'di ni mau mgal bu zhes pa shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa zhes pa'i 'khor rdzu 'phrul can gyi mchog yin no gsungs nas/ khyod rang la ji ltar yod pa'i rdzu 'phrul cig ston gsungs pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams de skyil dkrung gcig gis khebs par byas/ de nas kyang gsung thos pa la/ de nas de la tho brtsams pa'i nyes pas der 'gro bar ma nus pa la/ gsung nyid la gsol ba thob gsungs nas btab pas mi mjed du slebs pa bzhin no/ /gsung thams cad pa ni lha'i skad du chos ston pa nas/ gdul byar gyur na 'jag ma'i srin bu yan chad la rang rang gi skad du chos ston pa'o/ /thugs thams cad pa ni/ mdo las/ rma bya'i mdongs ni gcig bu la/ /rgyu yi rnam pa ji snyed pa/ /kun mkhyen min pa'i shes bya min/ /de mkhyen pa ni kun mkhyen nyid/ /ces so/ /gzhan yang chos rje pa gsungs zer nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten pa'i thugs bya ba la mnyam par bzhag na/ tshogs lam chen po yan chad kyis ting nge 'dzin 'di la mnyam par bzhag pa shes/ 'das pa'i thugs la bzhag na/ 'jam dpal/ byams pa sogs kyis kyang mi mkhyen gsungs/ 'di las 'phros nas snang ba gsum kyi khrid logs na ste/ snang ba gsum gyis lam gyi gzhi bcas la/ /zhes so/ /chos rje pa der yang lam 'bras tshar gcig song gsungs/ kun gzhi'i rten bla chen gyi dus na khams gsum zer/ rten dkyil 'khor bzhi yang ya gyal la yin grub sde gcig ste/ rtsa gang na yod pa na gzhan gsum pos khyab ste/ rtsa 'khyogs pa rnams yi ge'i dbyibs su yod/ de'i nang thams cad khams kyis gang / de la rlung gis khyab bo/ /mngon pa nas kun gzhi'i dmigs rnam mi gsal bar bshad pa dang /

'di pa gsal bar 'dod pa 'gal lo snyam na mi 'gal te/ pha gir tshogs drug bzhin mi gsal ba la dgongs/ 'dir bem po las log par rig pa'i ngo bor skyes pa'o/ /rten tshul ni grub sde gcig ste me tog dang dri bzhin zer kyang / rdzas gcig yin te/ kun gzhi log kyang rten phung po shul du lus pas so/ /bla ma 'u yug pas 'jim gong 'dra zer te don gcig 'di las 'phros nas 'khor 'das dbyer med logs na gzhung don gyi 'bras bu nus mthur tshang zhes pa ni/ rkyen gyis gang bskul ba'i 'bras bu 'byung ste/ bden bzhi'i rkyen gyis nyan thos dgra bcom/ de bzhin du rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyis rang rgyal/ phar phyin drug sogs kyi grangs med gsum gyis 'bras bu/ rim gnyis kyi rkyen gyis bskul na bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa 'byung ngo / /der yang ma zad tshe 'dir yang 'phen pa btang pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ste/ thos bsam bsgom bsgrub bam/ zas nor la sogs gang 'phen pa btang ba bzhin 'grub gsungs/ lus thabs rgyud kyi skabs su/ lus la gnad du bsnun pa 'di zab pa'i gnad cig yin te/ rje pa na re/ phar phyin dang gnyis kyi khyad/ mgo na ru yong snyam pas na ba dang / dbyug pa brgyab pas na ba bzhin gsungs/ chos rje pa 'dis gnad sman pas go gsungs/ bla ma kha che ba don mo rir byon/ der rol mo khrol bsu ba byas pas/ rab tu byung pa 'di ltar byed pa gsungs nas/ dang po ma mnyes/ der dus byin gyis brlabs nas byed pa lags byas pas mnyes/ de nas ston pa cig na re/ lus dang sems la gnad du bsnun pa gang zab zhu yin 'dug kha che bas khyod ltar na gang zab gsungs pas/ kho bo sems la gnad du bsnun pa zab zer/ 'o na sangs rgya ba la rten gcig dgos sam mi dgos/ dgos na ri lta bu tsog pu zhig la rten nam sogs dris pas/ de'i lan mi 'debs par 'brel med du tsa ri tsa gong gnas chen lags sam ma lags zer/

khyod gsang sngags bsgom mi bsgom gsungs pas/ khos ma go ba la/ chos rje bas brda sbyar bas gsang sngags mi bsgom zer/ 'o na gnas chen yin nas ci byed/ min nas ci byed gsungs pas/ de mi bsgom ste phyag chen bsgom zer bas/ rgya skad du ngan smras mang ba zhig byung / bod ba glang sngags mi bsgom de bsgom zer ba de ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam yin na/ khyed bod la chos nor pa las mi 'dug gsungs te/ da lta shin tu mang / des na lus la gnad du bsnun pa zab ces gsungs/ thabs rgyud la thog mar spyi don/ de nas gzhung don mdzad/ dang po la dbang dang 'brel ba'i gdan sogs dang / lam dang 'brel ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ bum dbang rgya che ba dang / mchog dbang zab pa'i gdan sogs so/ /dang po la gnyis/ lha'i gdan ma lus par tshang pa la gdan gsum rtsi ba dang / 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa lta bu la rtsi ba'o/ /dang po ni/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi dkyil 'khor la dngos su tshang ste dbus su mi bskyod pa/ gzhan bzhi phyogs su ste lnga ni sangs rgyas kyi gdan/ dbus su reg rdo rje ma/ spyan la sogs pa bzhi ni rig ma/ sa'i snying po la sogs brgyad ni byang sems/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi ni lha mo/ gshin rje gshed sogs bcu ni khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan no/ /'o na 'khor lo bde mchog la tshang ngam snyam na tshang ste/ dbus kyi gtso bo ni sangs rgyas/ rdo rje phag mo dang snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ni rig ma/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo nyer bzhi byang sems/ dpa' mo nyer bzhi lha mo'i/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni khro bo khro mo'i gdan no/ /'o na bir+wa pa rang gi dang po dbang thob pa'i bdag med lha mo bco lnga la tshang ngam snyam na tshang ste/ dbus kyi bdag med ma rnam shes dag rdo rje ma sogs bzhi ni gzugs sogs dag pas sangs rgyas kyi/ puk+ka sī sogs bzhi ni 'byung ba bzhi dag pas rig ma/

thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje sogs ni byang sems/ gau rī sogs bzhi dang steng 'og gi lha mo gnyis ni yul gzugs sogs dag pas lha mo/ yang gau rī sogs kyi dgug gzhug gi las byed pas khro bo khro mo'i gdan no/ /yang khams pa mdzangs na re/ gzhan gong bzhin la/ gau rī la nya/ tsaṇ+ḍa li la 'khor lo 'byung bas mtshon nas bkra shis pa'i las byed pas byang sems kyi/ byang sems zla ba dkar pa sogs kyi mchod pa'i las byed pas lha mo'i gdan no zhes zer/ dpa' gcig la brtsis pa dkyus na'o/ /des na lha nyung pa dpa' bo gcig pa la'ang gsum tshang / mang ba dam pa dang po dus 'khor lha stong drug brgya la'ang de gsum las ma 'das gsungs/ 'o na rnam dag la brtsis na rdo rje phag mo la'ang tshang bas rgyu dus kyi dbang gi go chod do zer na/ bla ma 'u yug pa bka' yod med dam/ bshad ma bshad la rag las gsungs te/ 'on kyang de gsum tshang tshad la dbang du mi 'dod/ khong de skad zer na mi mtshungs/ 'dir 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa la/ la li ta'i bka' bkod pas so/ /gong ma zab pa'i 'og tu lam la brtsis pas dbang la'ang de las med gsungs/ gsang dbang rten can du bskur ba lta bu'i lung la res dbang rdzas la blo rtse gtad na/ thig le mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu de la bla ma'i bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs ma sangs rgyas kyi/ rlung lnga'i dwangs ma rig ma/ mig sogs skye mched kyis byang sems/ gzugs sogs kyis lha mo/ tshigs chen sogs kyi dwangs ma khro bo khro mo'i gdan no/ /dbang gsum pa rang dang phyag rgya'i dwangs ma la gong bzhin rtsi/ bzhi pa la rten pad+ma can gyi dwangs ma dang / de dang tshogs pa gcig pa'i rlung la rtsi'o/ /lam dang 'brel pa bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang rtsi ba las/ dang po la gnyis las phyi'i bskyed rim bum pa dbang rgya che ba dang 'dra/ nang gi pho brang lnga'i dbus ma sangs rgyas kyi zhes sogs dang /

lus dkyil kyi lha la rtsi ba bsam pas shes so/ /gzhung don gyi gdan ni/ lha gang du bskyed pa'i gzhi'am/ gnas la zer gsung yang / chos rje pa lha rang la zer te/ dper na mi che che la gdan phebs zer yang mi rang la zer gyi gdan la mi zer ba bzhin gsungs/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid ces pa'i skabs su/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po la/ sngon gyi drang srong rnams kyis lus kyi yi ge rnams gzigs pas/ ngag thams cad de'i nang nas rlung rgyus pa las byung par shes nas/ phyi rol tu yi ge de nyid bris pa ste/ de na sngar zhes pa yi ge la zer bas skabs 'dir de la gdan gsum rtsi gsungs/ lha'i ni/ brtag gnyis las/ gang phyir lus las byung ba sogs kyi don te/ de'ang lha zhes pa lus las skyes/ bde ba la rol/ khyad par du 'phags pa dang gsum ldan la zer te/ lus kyi stobs kun nas/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha rnams tshangs pa'i khur tshos sogs nas byung par bshad pas lus las byung / 'dod lha dpag bsam gyi shing dang bdud rtsi la gzugs khams pa bsam gtan gyi bde ba la rol/ yi dwags 'dre la lha ru byed pa las khyad par du 'phags pa de la lha zer/ rgyal ba gzugs sku la'ang lha zer te/ tshogs gnyis kyi lus las skyes zag med kyi bde ba la rol/ 'dod gzugs kyi lha las khyad par 'phags pa'o/ /skabs don dwangs ma la lha zer te dang po shes par zad/ gnyis pa dbang gsum pa'i nyams myong ste dga' ba bzhi'i bde ba la/ tha mal gyi sre pas bsdus pa las khyad par du 'phags pas lha zhes bya'o/ /ye shes ni/ rgya gar skad du/ dzñā na/ bod skad du shes pa zer ba yin/ ye bod kyis bsnan pa yin/ des na shes pa dang rlung gnyis bzhon pa dang bzhon pa'i tshul du tshogs pa gcig tu gnas pas rlung la gdan gsum rtsis so/ /de gnyis ni gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid kyis grub pas don dam glo bur dri ma sbyong bas kun rdzob yin gsungs/

gzhung don gyi gdan ni lha gang du bskyed pa'i gzhi'am/ gnas la zer gsung yang / chos rje ba lha rang la zer te/ dper na dge bshes che ge mo gdan bteg zer kyang / de rang la zer gyis gdan la mi zer ba bzhin gsungs/ de bas nye ru byas na rigs la zer te/ de'ang 'bras ming rgyu la btags pa la dper brjod na/ rgyu dus kyi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi po 'di yang 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin pas de la gdan gsum rtsi/ des na rgyu gdan gsum du byung pas dbang der mi 'ong kha med yin/ de bzhin du lam lta ba grub mtha'/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'ang rgyu'i rigs yin pas gdan gsum tshang ngo sogs dang pos dbang dang 'brel ba'i/ gnyis pas lam dang / yang dang pos rnam dag gnyis pas las byed pa'o gsungs/ gdan gsum ni dkyil 'khor bzhi ga la sbyar zhes pa ni/ spyir dbang bskur du 'gro ba la gdan gyi sgro 'dogs legs par shes pa zhig dgos kyis/ tshig tsam gyis mi phan/ des na rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus/ mdun bskyed/ bum pa'i lha/ nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i lha/ slob ma dang thams cad la gdan gsum tshang par shes pa gal che gsungs/ de lta bu'i dbang de rgyu dus su bla ma las legs par thob dgos pa la 'phros nas/ rje'i zhal nas/ lam sna dang po dbang nas 'dzin pa yin pas/ dang po dbang bskur ba la thob pa gal che/ de yang bka' yod la lhad med pa mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len dang bcas pa zhig la thob dgos te/ dper na snam bu legs po 'ong ba la rgyu nas gzab dgos/ rgyu rtsid pa lta bu la byas na snam bu legs pa mi 'ong / de bzhin du rgyu dus su byin rlabs lta bu zhig gis dbang gi go bcad nas/ lam rim gnyis bsgoms kyang 'bras bu rnal ma mi 'byung bas dbang la zab pa gal che/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa len pa la'ang mkhan po mthong thos dogs gsum gyi skyon med pa zhig dgos zer na/ de bas gsang sngags ngos phra zhib che gsungs/

des na rje pas chos rje pa la/ nga yan chad legs par byung pa yin/ khyod kyi tshe gzhug la 'ong gi ra tshang zhig tu phug gog cig gi steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad gcig bris/ lu gu zhig gi ske la bal 'dogs zhig dkris/ dbang bskur ram bya ba byed zer ba cig 'ong gsungs de chos rje pa'i thugs la nan ltar gcags par byung nas chos la gces spras cher mdzad/ gdams ngag ston pa la'ang nga rang gi dbang bskur dgos byas/ dbang la'ang yo byad dgos byas kyin dam dog cher byas pas nga'i ring la'ang 'os par byung gsungs/ rin po che pa la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams la/ da khyod tshos nga'i rtsar bsdad nas chos ci thod thod la ma 'jug sde snod dang mthun par lag len gyis/ de ltar ma byas na nga ngo tsha ba yin gsungs/ lar dus snyigs pas chos la dka' mod/ dper na lung pa'i phur ser ba chen po byung nas/ shwa brgal byung pa'i dus su/ sa phyogs thams cad chus 'khyer nas da bde ba'i sa rang med dam bsam tsa na/ rdo ba gcig chags/ de la gcig la gcig chags kyin gle kha bag tsam 'byung ba bzhin du/ dus snyigs pas chos thams cad med par/ lta ba'i shwa rgal byung nas chus 'khyer ba dang 'dra bar rgyu 'bras thams cad khyad du bsad/ da sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rang med dam bsam tsa na/ gang zag bstan pa dang mthun par byed pa zhig byung / de la gcig la gcig rten gyis bstan pa'i gle kha bag tsam 'byung ba yin pas/ de tsam re khyed tshos kyang 'ong ba yin gyis gsungs tshogs bsgom pa rin po che pa'i zhal nas de tsam rang yang dka' mor 'dug gsungs te/ khong la mi dka'/ chos rje ba na re/ 'on kyang zer ba skad kyis 'ong ba mi 'ong / so bra ldong ston gyi dpe gsungs/ so bras 'brog gseb tu phyin/ lhas ra gcig tu bsdad/ ka ye zho skyol/ mar skyol/ sha skyol byas nas/ de nas sa la bsdad zer ba skad kyis/ 'ong ba dar rlan phor gang las mi 'ong gi zer lo/

/de bzhin du ngas kyang zho skyol zer ba bzhin du thog mar smin byed kyi dbang dgos byas/ mar skyol zer ba bzhin lam rim gnyis pa 'bod byas/ sha skyol zer ba bzhin lta ba nyams myong dgos byas kyang 'ong ba dar rlon dang 'dra ba'i dbang ngam bya ba yin nam zer phag mo'i byin rlabs shig byas/ dpral bar btsag cig bskus/ lam sems 'dzin skyong ba zhig la byas/ lta ba yin zer med par lta ba la zhen nas btsun tshul dor/ rgyu 'bras tsho khyad du bsad/ brang la mdzub mo btsugs nas 'di ka sangs rgyas yin pas lhod glod la zhog bshad na bshad/ tshad 'khrugs sogs zer ba'i slob dpon zhig gi rtsar 'gro 'ong zhes yang yang gsungs pa la/ rin po che pa'i thugs dgongs la/ khong pa la mi mkhas zer ba ni med/ de 'dra ci dgos snyam nas dang po thugs tshig za bar byung ste/ dang po rang res ma go bar 'dug phyis bsams pas khong pa shin tu mad par 'dug gsungs/ bum dbang thob nas de'i lam bskyed rim bsgom dgos zhes pa la/ 'ga' zhig dbang bya ba chos sgo 'byed pa lta bu zhig lam bsgom rgyu la sogs pa zhig tu go 'dug ste min/ dper na dge slong gi sdom pa'ang cho ga las logs pa'i bsrung rgyu med pa bzhin no/ /'o na ji ltar yin na/ dbang dus su bla mas phung khams skye mched thams cad lhar byin gyis brlabs pa de ka lam dus su goms par byed pa yin te/ dbang lam gyi 'khor lo 'khor ba'o/ /lam la bum dbang dang 'brel pa'i chos lnga ste gsang dbang sogs kyang des 'dre'o/ /phyi'i bskyed rim la rgyas pa ni bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi ste rgyud rgyas pa'i lugs/ 'bring yan lag drug ste gnyis po logs na yod do/ /nang gi bskyed rim ni mngon rtogs dang 'brel ma 'brel gnyis las phyag len dang po la mdzad do/ /ngo bo nyid gsum skyong tshul gyi skabs su/ zung 'jug ma skyes na rlom la'ang bsgom ste/

dkar dmar sogs tshogs su snang ba 'di sems su thag bcad nas de la sems 'dzin pa dang po/ de rang na med pa yin snyam pa gnyis pa/ zung 'jug yin snyam pa dang gsum la sems 'dzin no/ /'o na de phar phyin dang khyad med do zer na mi skyon/ dgos pa ni ngo bo nyid gsum myur du skye zhing / rjes la las mi bsog pa yin gsungs/ 'ga' zhig grub mtha' bsnyogs nas kyang 'da' ka ma rtsi ste gnad ma go gsungs/ 'chi ltas la/ gnam stong la zla ba mthong ba/ sna'i rtse mo la snyung bu brgyab pa lta bu'i zug byung pa dang / gzhan yang tshe gzugs brtag pa bya ba/ nya'i nub mo lus gos med par byas/ lag pa g.yas su shing 'gal zhig bzung / g.yon khu tshur snying khar bcangs te grib ma'i snying khar drag tu bltas la nam mkhar bltas pas rang gi gzugs 'dra ba'i skye bo zhig 'ong / de'i gzugs ma nyams na nyes pa med do/ /yan lag nyams na na tsha 'ong / nag po thum thum mgo thur la bltas pa byung na 'chi'o/ /nges pa'i 'chi ltas chos rje'i slob ma gcig la byung / red mdar byung nas bdag 'di tsam na 'chi zer nas dpe rten 'dra yod pa phul te dbang zhig zhu zer/ der dril bu ba'i dbang zhig mdzad/ mo rang zer ba bden te ring po ma lon par shi rgyas pa ni jo bo rje dang / slob dpon zang tsha la byung gsungs/ 'da' ka ma'i skabs su/ chos rje pa longs spyod gtong ba rang yang gang mos sar gtong gi de ltar ma byas na blo la 'khren byung nas de mi thebs pa'i skyon du 'gro gsungs/ de bas da lta nas longs spyod mi 'dzin pa gnad yin gsungs/ 'pho ba yang da lta nas ma sbyangs na 'chi khar mi thebs te/ sa 'khyag gi mkhar lan bzhin gsungs/ de'ang gnyid du 'gro khar rang lhar bsgom pa dor la snang ba thams cad lhar bsgom/ de yang ngo bo nyid gsum dang sbyar zhing bsgom ste de'i ngang la nyal bas rmi lam du shar byung na thebs pa la the tshom med gsungs/

'od kyi 'pho ba la sogs sbyong ba'i dus su/ stobs kyi hūm̐ ngam/ hig gi lan cig gis hūm̐ de sngo hri li li mgrin pa'am spyi bo'i bar du drangs/ de nas yang lte bar dbab/ de 'dra yang yang bya/ thugs khar mi 'phang / gnad zin na rig pa zi bir ba'am 'pho ba snyam byed pa byung na thebs pa'i rtags yin/ 'ga' zhig hika kis tshe thung du 'gro zer te gnad ma zin na stong phrag byas kyang ring thung gang yang mi byed/ gnad zin na lan gcig kyang zi ba sogs 'byung ste/ lhag mo cher chos rje pas gzhan la dmigs pa bstan pas sku khams log nas chos chag gsungs/ las la sbyor ba'i dus su gzhu dang gyogs kyi dpe ni de gnyis shul du bzhag nas mda' rdo gang 'dod sar 'phen pa ltar lus shul du bzhag nas rig pa gang 'dod sar 'phen pa'o/ /gnad gsum 'dres pa ni lag pas ltag pa nas skyor ba gtong ba/ spyi bo'i sgo bsal ba/ sems kyi rten hūm̐ de lha dang bla ma tha mi dad kyi thugs khar 'phangs nas de rig pa drag tu gtod pa'o/ /sgras 'pho ba la 'od kyi gong bus bkag kyang chog ste dmigs pa gang sla ba gcig rang gnad yin gsungs/ chos rje ba seṅge gangs ri gcig nas gcig tu mchong pa na/ snga ma la mi chags shing phyi mig kyang mi blta ba bzhin/ sngar gyi phung po la ma chags par rig pa dpa' bskyed pa'o gsungs/ sgo dbye ba 'od kyi gong bu sel ba'o/ /rig pa brtan pa bzung ba ni bla ma'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ la rang gi hūm̐ thim pa'i ngang la rigs drag tu gtod pa'o/ /spyir yang 'pho ba byed pa la nyer len goms pa yod pa/ mthun rkyen gsol 'debs yod pa/ 'gal rkyen rnam g.yeng med pa gsum shin tu gal che gsungs/ thams cad mkhyen pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs so/ /gtum mo'i skabs su/ chos rje ba slob ma gcig tshe 'di la mig mi blta bar zhe nas chos shig byed pas khyed rang shes zer na/ slob dpon kun gyis kyang gdam ngag gi khrid shes pa dka' mo yin gsungs/

sngon 'gro'i khrid kyi maṇ+ḍal chus byugs pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan dang / 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyis kyang gling bzhi las 'bul mi nus/ de bas rnal 'byor pas ting nge 'dzin gyis phul bas bzang sogs bsam pas shes/ 'di ji tsam mang zhing yun ring na dga'/ rje'i slob ma jo bo phur pa 'dzin gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi me tog dman ma bsags pas sa skya bre tshad kyi brgya tsam byung pa rje pa la phul/ yan lag lnga sbyong gi'ang lag len mi ston gor rung re 'chad/ gsal ba rang sa ni shes pa gsal cha dang bcas pa sngar chos brjed pa tsho'ang gsal 'ong ba'o/ /lhug pa ni mi rtog pa ngang shugs kyis skye ba'o/ /ngag sbyang ni smra ba mang po rtog pa'i lo ma yin pas dor/ kha bton nar ma kun kyang skad chung ngu ma chag tsam bya/ yid sbyang ni bsam rtog gi las mang po mi bya/ mi 'grub pa'i tshe 'di'i phun sum tshogs pa'i bsam mno mang po mi bya/ byas kyang 'grub pa'i nges med/ grub kyang snying po med/ des na bka' gdams pa kun gsung ba bzhin/ gnag la 'khrid pa'i khyi rgan gyis/ /dmar la 'khyug pa'i wa gnyis mi zin zer ba bzhin nam/ brang spu brang dang rkyal pa chu thub mi 'phrugs pa bzhin tshe 'di'i rgyags kha ma nyams pa zhig dang / phyi ma'i lam sna zin pa gnyis rgyab bsnol yin pas tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos dor nas bsgom byed dgos pa yin gsungs/ chos rje pa yan lag bcu gnyis su mdzad de/ rang lam zab mo bsgom pa la dga' ba/ gzhan ma 'phrad pa la snying rje/ rjes bsngo ba'o/ /rlung gi rnal 'byor gtsor bzhed pa'i skabs su/ spyir ting nge 'dzin rnal ma zhig skye bar 'dod na/ rlung bsgom pa gnad du che/ de nang du ma zin na yon tan rgyud la skye mi srid/ tha na blo 'dzin zhig byed na rlung zin dgos/ de ma zin na sems ma zin te khong gnyis bzhon pa dang bzhon pa'i tshul yin pas so/ /gzhan pha bong chen po 'degs pa'am/

khur chen po 'khur ba la'ang rlung ma zin na shugs mi thon pas des na rlung bsgom pa shin tu gal che gsungs/ srog rtsol 'di yod pa rgyal ba'i yum nas rngan dgas sbyin pa tshul cad gsungs te nyams len rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'dis gsungs/ 'di'i yon tan ni dbus pa'i sgom chen zhig la byung ste/ khong gis srog rtsol bsgoms te a phyi 'bum pa'i ser kha nas bltas pas/ nang na mdo dkon brtsegs mchod pa dang bcas pa mthong / bgres po kun la dris pas yod zer/ yang bla chen gyi slob ma bsgom pa zhang chung pa bya ba nyi phug pa ste/ khong gis dang rang zhed du sgom du phyin pas gar log 'ong zer log ste khong rang gi slob dpon 'dre chen po'i zhar chos mdog pa byang grags can phyin pas/ khong sngags pa kho na la 'grang / nyin gcig chos ston zhig gsol gyin sman dpe gcig gzigs kyin bgrang / der khong gis ma 'grang mdzod/ de gnyis rab rab mnyam yin/ 'bring 'bring mnyam yin/ de'ang sngags pa gzhan gyis mi bdog gis byas pas/ de bas kyang khyed sngags pa la yon tan bya ba yod kyi zer slar 'grang / der khong gis 'o na bdag sngags pa'i zhan shos shig lags te/ ngas 'di la yi ge de bklag nyid rang gzigs mdzod/ yang na nyid rang klog ngas mnan byas pas/ khyod kyis klogs zer/ khong gis srog rtsol zhig bzung bklags pas ji lta bar byung / blo la yod pa yin bsam/ ma tshad nas klog zer bklags/ kyang ma tshad kyang de bzhin byung pas/ khong zhal yang mi sil bar phyag 'tshal zhing khyed grub thob tu 'dug pa ngas ma go da bzod pa gyis zer/ der grub thob kyi yon tan yang med de/ lar ma 'grang mdzod byas pas de nas mi 'grang pa zhig byung / gzhan yang gegs sel gyi mchog kyang 'di yin te/ bsgom chen slan mkhar ba la gegs thu mo gcig byung / kho rang gi bla ma 'bri khung pa can byon pas ma phan/ stag lung bzang zer gsang nas phyin pas kyang ma phan/

der yang 'ong bla ma gzhi mo lung ba rje pa'i drung du gshegs pa dang 'grogs phyin nas rje la zhus pas/ phan ni phan 'ong dbang zhig zhu dgos te khyod bsgom chen rtog pa byed dam gsungs pas/ rtog pa ga la bgyid shin tu'ang zhu zer/ kyai rdo rje'i dbang bskur srog rtsol bstan te sgoms shig gsungs/ bsgoms pas khong rgod bro nas nga bsgom chen thos chung la mgo bskor yin 'di bas zab pa zhig yod pas zhu snyam gtor ma zhig khyer phyin pas/ rjes mkhyen nas nyid kyi 'di min cis kyang mi phan no/ /'di rnying rus skyed la sgoms shig gsungs pas/ 'o na skyes bu dam pa yin pas mgo bskor min snyam ste bsgoms pas/ ring po ma lon par khams drag ste/ phyis sa skya pa'i rim gnyis thun bzhir bsgom pa'i bsgom chen bzang po zhig byung / phyis grong tsa na nga'i ro 'di sa skya mthong pa'i ri zhig la skyol zer nas bskyal lo/ /gnyis ka nas btang ba la dmigs pa dgu las/ dang po sna'i 'dom ser gzhan dkyus na'o/ /kha nas sgra bcas ni/ mgrin pa'i gnas su khams skyon can rnams ja skol bas sbu ba bzhin nag rug rug 'dug pas so bar na phar shar song ba la rig pa gtod/ nang du 'ong ba la rlung dang / khrag mkhris shas che ba la rim pa bzhin si sgra med pa dang / sgra bcas su 'ong du gzhug gsungs/ sangs rgyas yon tan kha sbyor lag na 'dug ces pas/ de la yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod de/ sngon rgya gar du rgyal bu gcig la pha'i chad pa byung ste yan lag tsho bcad pas sa phyogs khrag gis gang 'dug pa/ slob dpon ma tang gi rde bas gzigs pas snying rje skyes nas/ khyod kyis bsgom nus sam byas pas/ nga rgyal po'i bu yin snying rus che bas nus zer/ 'tsho ba sbyor ba 'dra yod dam byas pas/ pho nyas ster na chad pas bcad gzhan med zer/ der ba glang rdzi zhig la 'di'i 'tsho ba sbyar nus sam byas pas/ nga rang yang med pas bya ba la dman pa'i ba glang 'tsho ba yin mi nus zer/

bag tsam nus ma byas pas 'o na nga rang gi 'tsho ba'i phyed phyed kyis phan na sbyar zer/ der phan gyi sbyor cig byas te/ dbang bskur/ kha sbyar bstan nas bsgoms pas ring por ma lon par zug chag de nas yan lag bcad pa'i shul nas shing gi yal kha skye ba bzhin gsos byung ste grub pa ni tso rang gi pa'o/ /der ba glang rdzis gdams ngag zhus pas mi ster zer/ bdag drin che ba yin gyis zhu byas pas/ de tsam gyi drin la nga'i gdams ngag byin pa mi 'ong zer/ yang yang zhus pas gnang ste bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa ni gho rak+ṣa pa'o/ /khong gis glu blangs pa ni/ gho rak+ṣa ha ngu pa na na u tsa le zer/ bod skad du gho rak+ṣa dang rlung man pa la gdam ngag tu mi byed ces pa'o/ /rin po che'i mched po 'jam dpal bya ba la'ang 'di'i yon tan byung ste/ rta gsar ma bzang po bas mgyogs pa dang / byas 'gyur gyi brag bya ba me long 'dra ba yod pa la thar ba byung pas/ chos rje pas/ da khyod la yon tan zhig skye bar 'dug pas nga'i rtsar sdod la sgoms gsungs pas ma nyan te kong por phyin grub thob rtse snyung bya bar btags/ phyis rlung gis khyer/ kha sbyor la'o/ /gtum mo'i skabs su 'dir rlung gi dmigs pa re dang sems kyi re gnyis gnyis bsgom dgos pas sngar bas drag tu bsgom pa gcig yin gsungs/ 'di rnams nam zla dang na tshod dang nad gzhi dang sbyar te/ rlung dbyar/ gtum mo dgun/ mi rtog pa dpyid/ bde ba'i nyams skye bar 'dod na ston sgoms gsungs/ yang na tshod gzhon dus rlung / dar la babs na gtum mo/ rgas nas mi rtog pa'o/ /'di rnams kyi bshad pa min pa lus gnad sogs kyi phyag len dngos su mi 'cha'o/ kha zas kyi lcag ni/ sgom chen pa la kha zas bcud che zhing cha dbri ba gnad yin te/ de'ang gzhon pa dang khrag mkhris shas che na bcud chung ba/ rgas pa dang rlung can la bcud can no/ /bde ba'i thig le ni/

bltas pa dran pa mthong bas kyang bde ba snyam byed pa nyams thams cad bde nyams su skye bar bsgom gsungs/ nyams pa 'dra na/ gsang gnas lte ba snying kha spyi bo'i bar du thig le stod la bsgom/ skra dkar sa bon gyis spyi bor haṃ mgo thur bstan/ mdzod spur gyen bstan dang / suṃ dang / hūm̐ rnams rtsa dbu mas zung sbrel bar bsam/ rang bzhin gyis dbab pa nyer len gyi rgyu/ bsgoms pas 'phel ba lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen yin pas thog mar mchil ma bska ru 'gro ba sogs dkyus na/ 'di'i phan yon ni/ bla chen gyi slob ma dbus pa'i dge bshes rta rgan la byung ste/ khong gis gnam mtsho'i do la lo gcig gi rgyags khyer bsgom du phyin pas/ phyi lo dar zhig rgyags zad de/ 'di bsgoms pas ji skad bshad pa'i yon tan skyes/ slob ma kun gyis grongs yod snyam bltar phyin pas/ sngar bas bkrag mdangs cher song 'dug ste/ ci gsol byas pas gdams ngag 'dra bsgom zer/ yang lho pa'i ston pa gcig gis rje la khrid tshar ba'i lhag ma dge bshes rig 'dzin grags la bskyangs te bsgoms pas 'di'i yon tan byung / der 'di ltar byung zhus pas/ nga slob dpon yin pas bag tsam drag go /gzhan la ye ma smra khyod la yon tan gcig skye bar 'dug gi zer/ mchod khang zhig tu bsgoms pas/ nub cig khams pa tshan zhig mchod pa bya ba byed zer/ do re sgom chen yang gdan 'dren no zer bas snying had pa zhig byung / der gcig na re/ ma 'dren khong gi dge sbyor chag zer/ cig na re byon zer/ mi 'ong byas te ma nyan/ khos pang du khyer stan la bzhag mchod dpon byas pas blo ma bde grib byung ste grongs/ 'khor lo gnyis la brten pa ni/ rgyud las/ he ru ka dang phag mo zhal sbyor zhes pa zab par gsungs/ spyir gong 'og gi dmigs pa kun la 'byung yang 'di zab pas rtags lnga dang / rtags kyi rtags lnga yang 'di'i skabs su bshad/

'ja' tshon la 'phros nas nyams snang yin na nam phyed na dkar por yong / mi shes pa yin na srod tho rangs 'ong / gzhan yang sa 'og bong bu'i sgra sgrog sku gzugs mchi ma 'dzag pa/ mkha' la bu kha dod pa/ gson por ring bsrel 'dzag pa sogs mi shes pa yin te lho pa'i dge bshes gcig rje pa la mjal du byung / khong zhu don zhig bdog zer/ der chos kyi dri gtugs gcig yod pa yin snyam nas/ chos rje pas bzhugs pas khong mchan nas dar gyi thum bu zhig bton nas bdag la 'di 'dra zhig byung zer ring bsrel tshan zhig ston gyi 'dug pas/ rje pa dbu phur nas de nan ltar mi shis pas pho la thong gsungs pas/ cung skyengs pa dang sngar grub rtags su bzung bas ma rangs te lags zer mchan du sum khyer song / nangs par khong tsha ba la bos nas kha sang gi de nan ltar mi shis pas/ bar chad cig 'ong pas myur du thugs dam mdzod/ 'dir bzhugs na mthun rkyen nang nas bgyid gsungs pas re zhig yar 'gro zer song / zla ba gcig gnyis na grongs zer 'bul ba bskyel du byung / 'di bla ma grub thob pa khad byung ste gsang bas thub gsungs/ der chos rje pas zhus pas/ 'di yang na chos la/ yang na tshe la bar chad 'ong gin 'dug ste da lan tshe la byung 'dug gsungs/ man ngag sogs la rnal 'byor dbang phyug lus gnad tsog pu zab/ yon tan thams cad 'og rlung zin pa las 'byung / de la tsog pu gnad yin gsungs/ nā ro pa steng rlung zin na 'og rlung rang 'gags la 'gro ste/ ril ba zhabs tshags can bzhin de la skyil dkrung gnad yin gsungs/ me mar skya ni rdza kha phub zer yang / dar dkar gyi rkyal pa stong pa lta bu'o/ /grangs can grangs med bcu gnyis zer yang phyag len la nyer bzhi gnyis te zhe brgyad la mdzad/ 'di man chad snga ma snga ma'i steng du phyi ma'i dmigs pa bsgom par mngon gsungs/ 'khor lo la 'khor lo/ yi ge srad bu thams cad me'i rang bzhin te/

mdun rgyab sogs su ma reg par bsgom/ reg na sgur po sogs kyi skyon 'ong gsungs/ me 'bar ba nas kha sbyor nyer bzhi la bsdus kyang chog gsungs/ cher 'bar ba ni rang gi 'dom gang tshun chad la'o/ /'di rnams kyang me thu lu lu 'tshig pa lta bur mi bsgom gsungs/ 'di rnams bsgoms na dgun yin yang lus chab rom gyi nang du gzhug dgos pa snyam byed pa 'ong gsungs/ gtum mo bsgom pa ye shes bskyed pa'i rgyur 'gro dgos pa'i skabs su/ chos rje pa drod tsam la dmigs pa ni/ bya spyang rgan po dang 'dra ste/ gzhon dus su g.ya' gong dang gangs gong du phyin nas cho ma re tsam na/ rgas nas nyams bskyang rgyu med pas grog phug 'drar sdod gsungs/ drod rang 'dod na de bas thum pa re tsam nyo ba sla gsungs/ chos rje pa na re/ drod tsam skye ba mu stegs pa rang myur te/ sa skyar a tsa ra zhig byung pas/ chos rje pas rig pa ci shes dris pas/ drod myur du 'ong ba zhig shes zer/ zas 'dra byin nas de nga la thongs byas pas lte bar me rdog mar hril bsgom pa bslabs te bsgoms pas/ de ma thag drod byung ste/ rje la zhus pas/ mi tshe la bka' bkyon yong ma myong ba la da res byung / de mu stegs kyi yin/ yod nga la'ang yod/ de gzhan la bstan na sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams nub 'gro gsungs/ lta ba'i skabs su/ gzhon dus su he ldom bsres pa'i sgom gcig byed na/ bdag byin brlab bsgom dgos/ de'i sngon du bskyed rim mi 'gro kha med yin gsungs/ spyir 'di pa'i lugs kyi man ngag gi skabs su rgyud kyi lung mi drang / rgyud du de'i gsal ka mi gtod gsungs kyang / nyon mongs rang byung sogs log rtog shas che zhing / ting nge 'dzin du ngo shes dka' bas drangs gsungs/ de rnams ting nge 'dzin du ngo ma shes na las bsog des skye gnas dman par sbyor ba la tha mal dang khyad med gsungs/

tshig gi mchog grub pa'ang chos rje pa/ nyer len gyi rgyu yod la sad byed kyi rkyen med pa cig gi dbang du byas/ de min na sems can thams cad dus gcig la sangs rgya bar gyur cig byas na'ang / rgya'am te mi rgya gsungs/ gzhan gsung gcig gis du ma'i bar go ba sogs kyang 'dir ngo bo tsam thob pa la dgongs/ mthar thug sangs rgyas min pa la med gsungs/ 'chi khar dngos grub len dus yin te/ sngar goms pa yod na 'chi ba la 'tsher mi dgos/ dper na mi gcig thug chad pa la rta bzang po gcig 'ong nas 'di la bzhon zer ba'i tshod tsam yin gsungs/ stong gsal gyi nyams 'di 'chi khar tha mal pa la'ang skye ste ngo mi shes/ tha mal la gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal du 'ong / sngar sgom nyams yod pa gcig yin na ngo shes nas grub mtha' bsnyogs pa la sogs pa 'byung gsungs/ dbang gsum pa'i skabs su/ dbab gzung sogs kyi gnad yod pas/ rlung la dbang thob cing / tha mal gyi chags pas kun nas dkris man/ lam myur du bgrod pa zab pa'i gnad cig yin/ de las ldog na ngan song gi rgyu byed de/ pho nya ral gri'i so 'dra ba/ /zhen par gyur na spang bar bya/ /zhes dang / brtag gnyis las/ ma gsang sbrul dang chom rkun dang / /sa spyod me yi sdug bsngal byed/ /ces pa'i don ni ma gsang ba ni bde ba'i rgyu lus las nyams na/ nyes pa 'di ltar 'byung ste/ phyi ltar na sbrul te mdze nad dang / chom rkun te nor 'phrog pa/ sa spyod ni rgyal po'i gnod pa/ me ste bsreg pa'i nyes pa 'byung / nang du sbyar na/ dang po ni zhe sdang bdag rgyud la skyes pas ngan song gi sdug bsngal bskyed/ gnyis pa nyon mongs pas bdag rgyud kyi yon tan gyi nor 'phrog gsum pa ni bdag 'dzin gyis sa 'og ngan song du 'phen/ bzhi pas 'dod chags kyi mes bdag rgyud kyi yon tan rnams bsreg pa'o/ /yang ji ltar bye ba sogs ni/ rten bye ba dwangs ma lus la nyams pa/

dam tshig ni dbang ma thob pa rten pa/ ye shes ni tha mal gyi rtog pa'o/ /des na khams 'dus pa tha ma man chad kyi nyams su blangs/ las da lta'i min pas bshad pa'ang yam me las mi mdzad/ mi nyams pa bsrung dgos te/ de lus la mi gnas na ting nge 'dzin rnal ma rgyud la skye mi srid/ bskyed rim lta bu gcig la sems gnas 'phro la 'gros drag po byas pa'am/ khur chen po 'khur ba lta bus rngul 'dzag na'ang de'i cha nas yin pas sngar gyi ting nge 'dzin med par 'gro gsungs/ 'di'i lta ba dga' ba bzhi po 'di/ phyag rgya'i gzugs la blta ba sogs kyi dus su byang sems mgrin par byon/ spang bya rnam rtog rags rim 'gag bde ba'i nyams myong chung ba de rnams 'jug pa gcig tu 'ong / gzhan des 'gre zhes bla ma snyag gsungs/ 'da' ka ma 'chi kha'i rlung gis rtsa mdud grol bas tha mal la gnad gcod dang / rnal 'byor pa lam gyi grogs su 'gyur ba sogs sngar bzhin no/ /dbang bzhi pa'i lam la/ ngag 'dren zhi ba ni dal bus byed/ dang po skad rad nas 'gro/ byang nas gling bu lta bu 'byung / drag po ni ngar 'dren te/ rag dung bzhin rgyang ring po nas thos pa/ sa skyar bsgom pa kyi 'bar la byung / 'di gsang sgrogs su 'gro nyen 'dug pas phyis lag len bag tsam nub gsungs/ 'dar ba ni dper na 'khar phor la dbyug gus bsnun na de 'dar/ de 'dar bas chu 'dar ba bzhin no/ /'dis sngar rlung dang gtum mo'i skabs su rlung sems gnad du ma song pa thams cad gnad du gtong ba yin te/ dper na tshwa'am nas rdza ma gang gsigs pas dma' ru 'gro ba bzhin gsungs/ bdud rtsi'i bcud kyi don bdag rgyud sku lnga bsgyur nus pa la zer/ dang po bzung ba la yi ge hūm̐/ gnyis pa oṃ/ gsum pa ā la dbang / skyes bu byed pa'i lce 'phel sogs ni mtshan dpe'i cha mthun yin gsungs/ lte bar brtan tsa na 'gro ba'i yid du 'ong ba ni a thung nang ltar bshad pa'i phag mo yin pas/

de la mkha' 'gro ma'i grong zer/ de dwangs mas gang ba'i rten 'brel/ rgyu mthun la dwangs ma lte bar brtan pas skra dkar sogs med pa/ 'gro ba'i snying du sdug pa sogs sems kyi phan yon bdag rgyud la bde bas khyab pa tsam las med pas chung zhes pa gsum 'jug pa zhig tu 'ong / gzhan des 'gre/ mas brtan ni/ 'ga' zhig ro rkyang brtan zer/ rin po che pa dbu ma la bzhed de/ yon tan thams cad dbu mar 'dus pa las 'byung bas so/ /de ltar na 'das pa'i lam du 'gyur ro snyam na/ mi 'gyur te/ 'dir yangs su btang ba tsam yin/ 'das pa la grol dgos gsungs/ sgra la goms pa'i skabs su/ hūm̐ lte bar bsgom pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs gong bzhin/ hikis drangs/ ka his ngal bso zer te/ hika gi'i shugs la ka hi 'ong bas tha dad min/ tshe thung ba'i rtsod spong sngar bzhin/ sbyong ba'i dus su hiki gcig gi 'dren pa gong bzhin gnad zin na lan cig tsam gyis rig pa 'pho ba snyam byed de/ dper na rta bzang po grib gsos byas pa rkyen bag tsam gyis 'grog pa bzhin no/ /gshang gci gnyis dud 'gro dmyal ba go log ste/ sam+bu ṭir/ gci las byol song dag tu 'gyur/ /dmyal ba brgyad po ltung min las/ /zhes so/ /gci ba smraṃyur zer te/ k+ṣamarayuṃ gsungs/ spyi gtsug nas dbang med 'phos na gzugs med/ mig nas 'phos na mi sogs gang 'dod du'o/ /nang gi ni ka li dmar po gyen bstan gnyis kyi bar du/ a li dkar po thur bstan gyis g.yas dgag g.yon a li dmar po thur bstan gnyis kyi bar du a li dkar po gyen bstan re gsungs/ grong 'jug gi skabs su/ rang la yon tan yod la rgas nas gzhan don mi nus na'o/ /de'ang rgyal po'i bu sogs dgos kyi sdig can lta bu la bag chags dman pa'i rtsa yig yod pas mi nyan gsungs/ grong 'jug la'ang / rgyud dam tshig dang ldan pa dgos pas nub dang po sta gon gyi cho ga byas la/

ro la gu gul gyis bdugs/ khro bo'i sngags bzlas/ gnyis pa la bsgrub mchod bya ste bdag 'jug blangs la de nas rang gi rlung dang ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pa dang bstun sogs dkyus na/ sems gcig gis rten gnyis bzung bas mu stegs kyi bdag gcig pu rang dbang can gyi log rtog khegs zhes chos rje ba gsungs/ 'di dgos pa che ste/ tshe 'phos na mngal gyi dri mas sngar gyi yon tan rnams brjed nas ka kha nas slob dgos pas so/ /chos rje pa 'di dka' mo rang min gsungs/ 'di dang po rgya gar du mang du byung / bod du mar pas mdzad zer/ yang dbus kyi yol sbu sder kong ni ru pa bya ba zhig byung / yul rgya gar zangs gling pa yin/ khong gis snyal du phyin/ rgan rgon gnyis kyi mchod gnas mdzad/ lan cig khong gi bu zhig yod pa shi nas sdug bsngal ba la khong gi bu ma shi bar log byung na chos byed du 'jug go /'jug na ngas bslangs la 'ong byas pas/ de da 'jug ste zer/ khong gis ro de khyer song nas zhag 'ga' na bu byung / khong ma byung pas grong 'jug byas sam zer/ bu la gang pa yin byas pas zangs gling pa yin zer/ lo du lon byas pas drug cu zer te/ sems kong ni ru pa yin pas so/ /de la gzhan kun snyal du skyes pa'i zangs gling pa/ /drug cu lon pa'i gzhon sha can/ zer/ rje pa na re/ 'da' ka ma'i dus la sgo dang dmigs pa'i rten 'brel gyis sdig can yin yang skye gnas bzang po gcig tu cis kyang skye ste/ sngar gyi sdig pa mi 'dzad pas bshags dgos gsungs/ 'di pa bar do zhar byung du byed/ 'ga' zhig 'bras bu logs na yod pas lnga'i ya bo bar do yin zer te dpyad du rung / de'ang tshe 'dir grub mtha' ma bsnyogs na 'da' ka ma gcig thebs sam blta/ ma thebs na bar do sbyang ba gal che/ 'dir cis kyang 'bri dgos pas so/ /de la spyir bar do zhes pa ni tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gags/ phyi ma'i snang ba ma shar ba de la zer/

de la 'byung bzhis bsdus pa'i lus tsam yod kyang rnam smin sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i lus med pas rig pa shin tu col chung pa cig 'ong / de'ang dbang po kun tshang zhing / zas su dri kho na bza'/ de'ang las kyi che ba ma'i mngal/ byin rlabs kyi che ba rdo rje gdan la thogs/ gzhan dngos po gang la'ang thogs pa med pa zhig 'ong / de'ang slob dpon thogs med kyis gang du skye bar 'gyur ba de'i byad gzugs so zhes gsungs/ gsang 'dus pas zhag phyed dang bzhi snga ma'i phyed bzhi phyi ma'i gzugs su 'ong bar bshad/ lus ma long na zhag bdun nas na 'chi snang re yong bar bshad/ lus bye brag can dang / bye brag med pa la sred pa/ sngar gyi nye du rnams kyi lad mo byed pas bdun tshigs byas na shin tu phan/ bar do'i rig pa de bsgyur kha ni yang ste chu'i steng gi shing dang 'dra/ chos rje pa/ nam mkha' nas chu 'bab pa la bar snang du snod bzed na/ longs spyod du 'ong la/ sa la babs na mi 'ong pa bzhin gsungs/ de'i dus su 'jig pa'i sgra bzhi 'byung ba sogs mngon pa'i rgyas bkab nas rgya cher gsung yang ci rigs par sbyor/ de la sngon 'gro sbyang ba dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po bzhi po rang rang gi mgo na yod kyang / yar blangs nas thog mar sbyang ba gsungs/ de'ang nges pa ni zas lag tu byung ba dang / bla ma sogs gsum po dran par bya/ brjed na 'dun pa drag pos yang yang bya/ nges med 'brug glog me chu sogs kyi sgra/ sngar med kyi gzugs mthong pa sogs la dran par bya ste/ gtso bo bum dbang gis sbyang ngo / /de nas dngos gzhi la 'chi ba'i tshe 'byung bzhi rim gyis thim nas 'chi ste/ sa chu la thim dus su sa'i nus pa shor nas lus kyis 'khrang mi tshugs/ de dus su du ba sogs kyi snang ba 'byung / chu thim pas kha sna sogs skam/ me thim pas drod bsdud de stod smad nas 'dor tshul mngon pa bzhin no/ /rlung thim pas lus bsgul bskyod mi nus/

rnam shes thim dus su re zhig rlung sems thams cad dbu mar tshogs pas stong gsal gyi nyams skyes nas de'i ngang du 'gro/ de la tha mal rnams brgyal ba/ lam pa rnams 'od gsal zer/ 'di sdig can la'ang 'byung ste/ goms pa med pas ngo mi shes/ de las sad nas bar do'i snang ba 'byung ste/ sngar gyi 'jigs snang sogs 'byung bas skyabs 'tshol ba 'ong / der dri kha dog gi tshul du za bas de dang dus mnyam du bsnam bya lnga kha dog lngar 'char/ 'od dkar po la zin na dmyal ba zer te nag po/ der sngar gyi goms pa dang rten 'brel gyi che bas bsnam byas rkyen byas nas bla ma sogs dran pa 'byung ste dkyus na/ dam tshig 'bring zer te/ de med na 'chi dang 'chi kha sogs su dngos grub mi thob pa kun la dgos/ ril bu rab thun bzhi'i mgo mjug la re re ste brgyad/ 'bring thun mgo la re re bsten pa sogs dkyus na/ zas kyi rnal 'byor gyis kyang 'di'i nyes pa khegs/ 'di da lta bsrung par 'gro/ phyis zas kyi phyed dang / gtsang btsog med pa sogs gnyis spangs kyi spyod pa la myur du 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod gsungs/ 'di la 'phros nas bdud rtsi ril bu'i ri lu bsgrub pa logs na'o/ /rdor dril la brda don gnyis las/ brda'i ni phyag mtshan rab gnas sogs dang ldan pa 'chang / gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /sogs kyi don dang mi 'bral bar bya/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i dam tshig nyams na ngan song du sdug bsngal cis kyang myong dgos pas mi nyams par bsrung zhing nyams na bshags pa'i phyir bcos pa gal che/ legs grub kyi lung dkyus na/ legs grub las/ mtshan mo bag med byas pa dag sogs/ gzhan yang seṅge dkar po kho dgong mo'i dus su kho'i g.yu ral dang sder sen la gzhan gyis gnod pa byas ma byas bltas nas/ ma byas na dga' ba/ byas na byed mkhan tshar gcod/ de bzhin du 'o skol yang srod la/

nyin mo nyes ltung gis gos ma gos blta/ ma gos na dga' ba bsgom/ gos na 'gyod pa drag pos de ma thag bshags pa byed de/ rgya mtsho ro dang zhag tu mi 'grogs pa bzhin no/ /mkha' 'gro ni gya gyur 'gro ba la zer/ 'dod yon sogs la 'dod yon yid la 'dod bya sogs phyi'i lnga sogs dang pos nang rig ma/ gnyis pas mnyes pa'i don du sogs khongs su mgu bar bya rengs par byas la/ dam tshig nyams na dbang zhu'o/ /mnyam gzhag nyams na lta ba zhes pa la bla ma 'u yug pa spyi lugs kyi 'bras bu nyams na rgyu la nan tan byed dgos pa la 'di de las ldog pas ma go gsungs pa la/ nor ba'i don te/ rin po che pa tshad ma'i bskyed bya skyed byed kyi rgyu 'bras lta bu mi nyan yang spyir nyan te/ mnyam gzhag gi nyams pa ni/ bskyed rim la blo dred nas sems ye gnas su ma 'dod na bzod de bzhag nas rgyu dus kyi lta ba rjes thob sna tshogs kyi snang ba 'di rang gi sems su thag bcad/ de sgyu ma/ de rang bzhin med par byas te bsgoms pas dmigs pa gang rung zhig la sems zin 'ong / de nas sngar gyi bskyed rim gyi steng du log ste bsgoms pas sems zin 'ong ba la dgongs gsungs/ thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo'i skabs su 'ga' zhig dbang byas pas chos sgo 'byed pa lta bur go ste min sogs gong bzhin gsungs/ lam dus kyi dbang 'di rnams bklags/ lam dus kyi dbang bsgom pa bzhin tshig thams cad rdzogs par bshad do/ /bsdus pa'ang mngon rtogs bzhin bshad/ ming la dbang rdzas med pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'phags pas sbyang gzhi gzugs phung rags pas zung 'jug mtshon gzhan la de dgos pa'ang 'gre/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /zhes pa ni dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes de so so rang gi rig pa las sgra dang rtags sogs kyis mi rtogs pa'i rdo rje ni dper na pha lam gyis sra ba brag sogs 'joms shing tshur mi phyed pa ltar/

ye shes des kyang mtshan 'dzin 'joms shing / tshur mi phyed pa'o/ /nam mkha' la 'gro 'ong thog mtha' mtha' dbus skye 'jig med pa bzhin ye shes la'ang med do/ /rdul nyon sgrib dang bral/ zhi ba shes sgrib spangs/ mthar phyin pa bcu gsum pa'i ye shes mngon du byed pa'i rten 'brel sgrig ces pa'i don no/ /pha ni dbang bskur ba'i bla ma/ de'ang phyin chad khyed rang gis khyed rang gi pha gyis la sngar gyi ye shes skyongs zhig pa'o/ /'bras bu'i phyag rgya ni lam bzhi bsgoms pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu lta ba bzhi pos rnam rtog la rgyas 'debs pa la bya gsungs/ yang na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la sbyar na rang yang 'grig gsungs/ rgyud kyi sku gsum rgyun mi chad pa ste/ chos sku rtogs pa ye shes/ longs sku theg pa thun mong ma yin pa'i chos 'khor/ sprul sku 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'o/ /'di pa rtog pa kha 'tshoms sems 'dzin bskyang ba la phyag chen mi 'dod/ des mtho na gzugs med/ de min dud 'gror 'phen gsungs/ des na lta ba rnal ma zhig skye bar 'dod na/ thos bsam gyis thag bcad de/ rim gnyis bsgoms pa las byung pa'i nyams myong nang nas skyes pa de rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i phyag chen yin gsungs/ de yan chad rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam ste/ der yang lam 'bras tshar gcig song gsungs/ tshad ma ba'am rtog ge ba dang go ba len lugs cung mi 'dra/ dmigs pa rlung gi 'dren tshul sogs bya ste bsgom pas dkyus bzhin/ nyon mongs rang byung skyes pa'i tshe gdam ngag gi rgyus med pa gcig la nga la 'di ltar byung byas na/ gdam ngag nor ba min nam/ bsgoms rtags nyon mongs chung pa yin zer kyang / de nga rang la rgyus yod/ nang gi rlung sems kyi rten 'brel las byung pa'i nyams thag chod nas mos pa gzhan gyis 'phrog par mi nus pa de nyams myong tshad ma/ des 'og ma tsho'ang 'gre'o/ /de gnyis ka bla ma'i zhal nas/

khyod kyis da lta ma bsgom pa yin/ lan cig dkyus bcu gcig gi sgoms shig byas na chags sdang lnga'i yi ger rlung sems 'dus pas nyon mongs rang du skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa thog tu phebs pas bla ma la mos gus khyad par can skye ste/ nga'i bla ma 'di rje sangs rgyas su 'dug pa'i nyams la skye ba de bla mas sngon du thugs su tshud 'dug snyam nas mos pa gzhan gyis 'phrog par mi nus pa de bla ma dam pa'i man ngag nyams kyi tshad ma/ 'og ma rnams 'gre/ gsum pa phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad thugs la chud pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu 'dug snyam pa'o/ /gzhan dkyus na/ bzhi pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas rnal 'byor pa'i nyams 'ba' zhig gsungs 'dug snyam pa'o/ /'og des 'gre/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' ni/ tha ma mu stegs kyis kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi lugs kyi nang gi rlung sems 'du tshul las byung par bzhed de/ sngar 'du ma myong pa'i khang stong lta bu'i rtsar 'dus na skye ba snga ma med pa'i nyams 'byung / de nas 'pho ma nus na phyi ma med pa sogs kyi nyams 'byung gsungs/ chos sku'i nyams gzhan la smras na/ khyod kyi sdug sran nam/ shes rab kyi tshod kyis 'ong thang yang thang ste mthong lam skyes pa min nam zer na/ sngar bzhin/ des na tshad ma bzhi gung bsgrig tu rung ba'i gdam ngag gcig 'dug na yid brtan rung gi 'phral 'jar 'jar 'dra yang mi rung gsungs/ des na mi rtag pa bsgom pa'am/ 'dul ba'i lag len gcig tshun la de bzhi tshang dgos te bsam pas shes/ des na chos rje pa'i zhal nas/ chos 'di shes rab kyis go bsam ste/ bsod des go bar 'dug sde snod 'dzin pa kun kyang nyams len byed tsa na/ sngar gyi sde snod rgyab tu dor nas ci yin cha med re la 'ju yin 'dug ste/ dper na dbu ma bzhi brgya pa nas skyes bus rdo brdar nas chu la skyur ba'i dpe sogs gsungs/

'di la 'phros nas lung sbyor logs na yod/ da ni sgrub pa po la myur du phan 'dogs pa'i gdams ngag drug gsungs/ chos rje pa u pa rde sha gsungs/ zhen ldog dkyus na/ bying ba ni khang stong lta bur rlung sems 'dus pas dran med du song na/ thog mar ting shag de nas rnga dang dung sogs kyis slong ba'o/ /'thor bsdud dkyus na/ ma rig pa'i dug ni dge mi dge la blang dor du mi shes pa'i blo sbram theng ba gcig yin gsungs/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod dgos pa ni/ chos rje pa de shin tu gal che/ da lta 'ga' zhig ri la lo che che tshod gcig bsdad zer/ nyams myong ci yang med pa'i rigs 'ong gin 'dug nga la nyan na lo bcu thos pa byas nas bsgoms na rnal ma zhig 'ong ste gsungs/ zhe 'dod kyi lta ba ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid la gang zag gi blos phigs ma nus pa'i bye brag gis go lugs tha dad byung pa yin te/ gzung 'dzin bden par 'dod pa la ming nyan thos bye brag tu smra ba/ de bzhin du lkog na mo bden par 'dod pa dang / snang snang sems su bden par dang / kun rdzob sgyu ma/ don dam stong nyid du 'dod pa la rim pa bzhin ming mdo sde pa/ sems tsam pa/ dbu ma pa zer te de la zhen pa'o/ /rgya mtsho'i don sogs ni/ de la 'dom bcu gnyis man chad g.yo 'gul gang gis kyang mi nus te/ de yan chad du rba rlabs 'byung / de bzhin du thos bsam gyis mnar med nas sangs rgyas kyi bar rang bzhin med par go ba rgya mtsho mi g.yo ba dang 'dra yang / myong ba med pas rnam rtog rba rlabs 'dra ba la bya gsungs/ rtsol ba'i dug ni nyams myong med na tshig la mkhas kyang rnam rtog spong mi nus te/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen bzhin zer te ma grub/ rnam rtog rgyun chags spong ba la zhi gnas dgos te/ chos rje pa na re/ lar 'chad pa pos kyang skye med du/ nyan pa pos kyang skye med du/ sgom pa pos kyang skye med du bsgom pa sogs byas kyang skye bcas su na re 'ong ba ni cis lan na/

nyams myong med pas lan te/ dper na ngas bsam yas su phyin pa'i rmi lam dang 'dra gsungs te/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar na yod/ yum gyi bdud rtsi ni/ chos rje ba/ tha mal gyi 'dod pa dang bsgom pas 'dod pa gnyis 'ong ste mi 'dra/ snga ma spyad cing thur 'gro/ phyi ma lta bas thag bcad de rten pas ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs byed gsungs/ yang chang dad can la bzi ba blud pas tshim pa bzhin no/ /yang bu chung ngu gcig la yul phyogs che cher ltad mo 'ong byas pas/ kho 'gro ba ring nas mi nyan pa la/ der phyin 'bag 'chams sogs bstan pas da 'dong zer phyin pas gnyid du 'gro ba bzhin gsungs/ nyams skyon can brgyad kyang ting nge 'dzin yin te/ bla ma zhang dgon pa ba na re/ lar skyon med skye ba la skyon can dgos te/ de rang yang dka' mor gda'/ dper na ne le 'dzin pa la bya rog dgos te/ de yang zin pa dka' ba bzhin gsungs/ khor re gog po 'khrud pa la dang po mi gtsang du 'gro ba de 'dag pa'i rtags yin pa'am/ me dron po 'ong pa la du ba dgos pa bzhin no/ /phal cher thog mar skyon can skyes nas gdod skyon med skye ste bdag rgyud la bag chags dman pa yod pa sngar rkyen gyis sad ma nus pa bsgom pa'i stobs kyis sad nas de byung rgyal gyis bskyangs pas skyon med kyi sna 'dren yin gsungs/ bsgom zad pa ni/ dper na mi mkhas 'ga' zhig rta slud cig la 'di bzang po yin byas ma gsos par skol na rta god yong / de bzhin du 'ga' zhig dal 'byor gyi she mo bcad 'tshal zer lus dka' thub kyis gdung drags na ting nge 'dzin gyi bar chad du 'gro gsungs/ mkhas pa dag rta slud de gso ba sogs go sla/ rta slud de ljang pa dang / slum sogs kyis gsos te dal bar bzhag na phyis bcu gal thub pa bzhin/ de bzhin kha zas kyi bdud rtsis lus zungs rgyas nas ting nge 'dzin skye bas so/ /sngo rigs kyi sogs khongs su/

zwa/ bra 'o/ sran ma/ bu ram nag po sogs kyis khams zad par byed pas so/ /gzhan pa mi gzhan pa rims nad min pa chu'am/ mtshon gyis shi ba'i sha de/ rang khrag mkhris shas che na lan gsum tsam/ rlung shas che na lan gcig tsam btsos pa de btsid pa'i bar du bcug rdo tshan sde gnyis kyi bar du bsdams la chu ser thon pa dang chu rgyus med par byas pa de skams la zhib pa byas pa de/ byi ba'i rkang rjes tsam re lto stong la bsten nas sngar bzhin no/ /phyag rgya de bdud rtsir 'gyur te khams zad par byed pa min nam zer na/ rlung gi gnad sogs med zad byed yin la/ gnad yod na 'phel byed yin te/ dper na mes rngul 'ju bar byed la/ skem par yang byed pa bzhin no/ /lus ngag byung rgyal yang / tha mal gyi bzhin gang byung byung du gtong ba min/ lta ba'i rtsis zin par byas nas byed pa yin/ la dor zhes pa 'di bas lhag pa'i thabs med de 'di'i mi sel mi srid ces pa'o/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa ngan te/ der gags byung na bsal dka' bas lkog 'bras sogs 'ong / snying khar gru gu lta bu'i nga bdag tu 'dzin pa yin/ skra shad 'dzings pa lta bus tshigs la rma byung ba 'tsho dka' ba yin/ tshigs chen la rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa re gnas la/ de re re la nad 'du ba bzhi bskyed pa'i yi ge bzhi bzhi ste/ rlung bskyed pa'i ya'am ho/ khrag gi ra/ bad kan gyi sa/ 'dus pa bskyed pa'i e gnas so/ /ro rkyang gnyis kha gyen thur gyi rgyu mtshan gyis skyes pa bud med la dkar mar 'dzag pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba las 'phros nas mngal gyi dus na thig le dkar dmar gnyis snying kha na gnas shing / rlung kha sbyar du yod pas lus mi rul ba sogs kyi rten 'brel/ btsa' ba'i dus su kha sbyor zhig pas snying had pa zhig 'byung ste khams gnyis yar mar du 'gro ba'o/ /snyan brgyud kyi gsang sngags ni zab mo'i gnad 'di tshangs pa/ brgya byin/ mu stegs dang nyan rang sems tsam dbu ma/

der ma zad sngags kyi'ang rnal 'byor rgyud man chad la'ang ma grags pas na gsang ba/ sngags ni de nyams su blangs pas yid skyob pa'o/ /snyan brgyud bzhi ni 'og nas/ rgyu dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ni/ dper na ya tha skye pa bye ma g.yu rung ma tha rgya mtsho'i bar du chu rgyun ma chad pa bzhin no/ /byin gyis brlabs la tshig gi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa dang / don/ brda'i dang gsum las/ dang po rdo rje 'chang nas/ bla ma'i bar du/ 'di'i skabs su 'di ltar gsung gi tshig ma bcos pa zhig dgos kyi/ 'byar 'byar 'dra mang po bsgrigs kyang phyis ci yang mi btub/ zur shag 'byung gi rgyab steng pas mdun shor ba bzhin gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ slob ma 'khrid pa/ rang nyams su len pa/ 'bras bu'i dus dang gsum du/ rten 'brel lnga'i tshul gyis byed pa zhig yin gsungs/ gsum pa ni bar chad bsrung pa'i don du lus brda sogs chig brgyud du thob pa zhig dgos gsungs/ nyams su blangs pa'i mtha' dbang dus su bla ma'i zhal 'dir/ slob ma 'dir/ bum pa/ rdor dril/ mchod pa 'di ltar bshom sogs dang / lam dus su lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ rlung gi 'dren tshul/ sems kyi dmigs pa 'di ltar byed sogs gong ma'i phyag len ma bcos pa zhig dgos/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtha' la mnyen lcug bzhi ni/ lus kyi spyod pa ma gcig gis nyin zhag mang por 'dug tshugs pa sku'i mnyen lcug yi ge dbyibs sna tshogs su bsgyur nas gzugs sna tshogs ston pa yi ge'i dwangs ma gang 'dod du drang bar nus pa bdud rtsi'o/ /rlung dbang po'i sgo thams cad nas gtong bar nus pa rlung gi'o/ /de la 'phros nas sa skyar phyag rgya ba mang po 'byung ba la/ bla chen gyis dwags po lha rje khams bzang ngam gsungs pas nan ltar ngan/ zhabs drag byung nas dngul chu'i nang du bcug tsa na bag tsam zug chag de min zug thabs med pa 'ong 'ong zer/

yon tan ci yod dris pas nang na rtogs pa bzang po bdog khyad par rlung gi nus pas sor mo'i rtse na phar rlung btang pas spos thal 'bud nus zer/ bla chen gyi thugs la yon tan brjod mi shes pa 'dug de gnyis 'gal de ltar yod na rlung gi mnyen lcug yin pas thal ba las dreg 'bud thang bsam ste zhal rog bzhugs gsungs/ nang gi mkha' 'gro'i byin gyis brlabs sogs dkyus na/ mos gus la gsum las/ dang po rgyu dus kyi mos gus kyis bsam pa tshim pa ni/ thog mar rtog dpyod byas nas yid ches pa'i bla ma zhig la gdam ngag zhus nas nyams len byed pa cig dgos/ de bas 'di zab bam snyam pa sogs blo so ma zin par sna tshogs la 'jug pa de la yon tan skye mi srid gsungs/ de nas rje'i zhal nas/ 'di nga la yod pa yin/ nga rang gi snying rus kyis byung na/ rgyags su gser 'khyer/ 'og tu rta bzhon nas btsal yang 'di bas zab pa'i gdam ngag med par thag chod snyam pa zhig nga la yod gsungs/ gnyis pa ni sgro 'dogs nang du chod nas yid ches skyes pa/ gsum pa 'bras bu'i ni mthar 'gros bzhi thim ste sku lnga lhun grub tu sangs rgyas pa de yang rgyu dus su yang dag gi gdams pa nyams su blangs pa la brten nas rten 'brel lnga rim gyis 'grig pa las byung pa zhig yin gsungs/ gzhi'i gsham du lus rtsa la bum dbang bskur nas lam bskyed rim sogs kyi sprul sku'i rten 'brel 'grig gsum pa 'gre dngos po'i zhes pa dngos med la min dngos po la sgrigs 'grig pas so zer/ pas so/ mtha' ni dang po dbang nas sa phyed dang bcu gsum gyi bar ro/ /gzhan dbang ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug sems tsam gyi paṇ+ḍi ta yin pas/ kun btags/ yongs grub/ gzhan dbang ngo / /zas spyod lam gyis sogs su gnas grogs sogs so/ /lam bzhi zer kyang 'jug sel/ chags spyod/ byang chub chen po dang gsum las tha ma'o gsungs/

kun gzhi'i rnam shes dag sogs la/ de dag pa me long lta bu des sgo lnga'i rnam shes dag pa bya grub/ yid kyi rnam shes dag pa sor rtog nyon yid dag pa mnyam nyid/ de thams cad kyi spros bral du rtogs pa chos dbyings ye shes so/ /mtshon nas tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa'i ye shes la zer gsungs te/ mdor na 'thob bya'i 'bras bu sku lnga ye shes lnga ldan gyi sangs rgyas shig yin zhes pa'i don to/ /phyi yul gyi rten 'brel bsam gyis mi khyab pa dper na tshong dus su zong glang po che'i mche ba la rin du sbang ma mi 'jal ba rten 'brel gyi che ba sogs rgya cher bsam pas shes/ gcig gi gcig mi bslu ba ni phyi yul gyi steng na yod tshad lus la rtsa yig tu tshang sogs bsam pas shes/ bsrung pa'i dbur bla chen na re/ las dang po pa'i dus su bsgrub phyogs gnad du che ste sprul sku lam du byed pa'i gnad yin/ sems brtan nas dgag phyogs gnad du che ste chos sku dang / sems cher brtan nas blang dor med pa gnad du che ste longs sku lam du byed pa'i gnad yin gsungs/ mas 'jug gi thabs phyogs su lhung ba la/ dang po bu tsha chung ngu rang nas 'ong ste/ gos zas rtsed cha sogs kyang gzhan pas lhag pa/ chos sgor 'jug kyang grwa sa mkhan slob dpe cha sogs gzhan pas lhag pa dgos pa zhig 'ong / gang zag de lam la zhugs pa na 'jig rten chos kyi bar chad 'byung ste/ de zhe nas chos gcig bya snyam tsa na bdud kyis blo bsgyur nas sngar 'dren byed pa'i nye du kun kyang / khyod med na rang mgo bo'i mig tshil 'don pa skad zer nas gros 'debs/ sngar sa khyem re tsam la 'thab pa de/ nor phangs med ster zhing ldog na/ sngar gyi dad bsam pa las mi 'gyur bar byas la bsrung ste dkyus na/ gzhan rnams kyang sa bcad mang po mi mdzad par 'chad lugs de bzhin no/ /bar chad dang po las thar te da chos byas nas gzhon nu dus su thos pa zhig bya snyam na/

bla ma sogs kyi bya byed la sbyor du byung na'ang sngar bzhin bsrung / de nas sgoms zhig bya snyam tsa na/ bla mas kyang khyod pher ba dang zer phye 'thor/ grogs sngar 'dzugs se byed pa kun kyang / sngar 'u cag 'dra se yin te/ da khyod shes rab che zhing mi byams par 'dug pas bshad pa gyis/ de lta na nga yang khyod kyi 'khor 'dus pa dang po rang byed pa skad zer nas 'du shes bsgyur ba'i tshul gyis bar chad byed na bsrung tshul dkyus na/ 'di zhu yas bzhin te/ khong gis slob dpon la sa skyar 'gro ba yang yang zhus pas/ lan zhig na/ nga mi rgan gcig btsun chung 'di tsho la kha lta dang / bshad pa byed pa khyod kho na'i ched yin na zer lan zhig bka' bkyon byung pas/ zhu yas kyis khong la bltas te/ 'o na 'o skol rang gi phar phyin nas/ bdud la la ni slob dpon dang mkhan po'i cha byad du 'ong gsungs ba'i ya gcig rang yas lags sam byas pas lan ma byung / de khar sa skyar 'ong lam 'bras gsan pas 'di'i thad kar khong rgod/ ci yin byas pas/ bshad sbyang byed dgos par 'dug pa la nga'i de cung drags 'dug zer/ phyi'i ni sngar de tshos ma chod na tha na bsod chung skyed nas kyang gcod de/ dbus chung ser po bzhin/ khong gis g.yog gcig dang bcas kong por phyin/ lung phug cig tu bsgoms dge sbyor 'phel/ der bla chen gyi slob ma yin zer grags pa byung / der gnas brtan sogs dbang zhu zer te mi shes byas/ g.yog gis rgyags bsgrub tu phyin pas khyod kyi slob dpon de jo bo bzang ste mi chos mi shes 'dug 'dir bsdod pa la nged slob mar gyur pas mi lto/ khyad par du khyod rang la rgyags kyi 'bad rtsol mi dgos pa la zer bas/ bden bsam slob dpon la bzlas pas/ kho'ang 'tsher ba yin bsam te/ des na dbang bskur bya ba las ma shes gsungs pas/ klags shig byung bsam/ khong tsho la da khyod rang dbang zhu ba 'dra'o byas te/

zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes/ der khong gi sar phyin dbang bskur byas/ khres thum g.yog la bkur/ khong rang blo skyog zur cig na yar thugs dam byed kyin byon pas/ dgon par brtol kha na/ grog nang zhig na mi 'dra ba tshan zhig btung rgyu zhig dbus na bzhag dbus chung 'dir 'ong na mar bar chad byas pas ye ma chod/ mdang zhag gnas brtan che ge mo sogs bskul nas dbang zhur bcug pas zhus/ da kho srad mas kyang khyer 'dug de bas dga' cig zer/ der mi ma yin gyis bar chad byas 'dug bsam/ der yang ma bzhugs/ mdo smad mtsho snying mahā rde'ur byon/ der yang sngar gyi dge sbyor 'dra ma byung spyir rang lan cig bar du bcad na de nas rnal ma mi 'ong gsungs/ yang rje'i slob ma lho pa zhig la'ang byung ste/ lar rje'i slob ma kun mos gus shin tu che ste/ me lcags re reng dong re tshags byas nas rje dang nam mjal ba na/ ring bu bsregs yan lag bdun pa re 'bul/ des na rje'i slob ma kun la phan thogs re ma byung pa tsam med gsungs/ khong gis kyang phyag cig phab na byin rlabs cig 'jug ste bsam/ na bza' la sbring 'jus pas phyag ma phab/ der khong gis dbus su phyin rab chad rgan rgon gnyis kyi mchod gnas mdzad/ rin po che'i brgyad stong pa cig 'dug pa 'bul zer/ 'o na bla ma la 'bul du 'ong bsam ste de bzhin mdzad/ dbang zhu ba mang po byung ste yun ring ma byas/ re zhig tsa na grong du phyin dbang bskur byas nas log 'ong pas/ spang gshongs shig na bud med mang po gad mo theg ge 'dug ste nyan pas/ na ning nas bar du ma chod pas mdang zhag grong na mar dbang bskur byed khyi bzhin 'khyam gyi 'dug zer/ 'o na bar chad byas 'dug bsam sa skyar 'ong / bsrung ba dkyus na/ rje pa da lta 'di shin tu zab pa yin gsungs nas khong rang yang srung skud 'khor lo 'dogs/ chos rje pa na re/ da lta go log nas 'dug las dang po pa ci yang mi shes pa kun stong nyid dam bya ba yin zer cho mar re/

bar chad byung tsa na bon po sogs kyi 'dre brdungs byed gsungs/ bdud stobs 'phel ba'i gong 'pho ba ni/ nang na ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan chung pa'i dus su yi dwags phra mo las chen po rnams mi yong ste/ dper na chu smig pa'i gog gsos bzhin/ de snyoms chung dus na rang dang mnyam pos gnod/ gog sa cher song gin gnod byed cher 'gro /mthar dpon pos kyang mi theg pa bzhin/ nang nas yon tan rnal ma zhig skye ba 'dra na kho'i go ra las thal 'gro bas chen pos bar du gcod/ des na phyogs skyong bcu ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi khongs su 'du bas phyag mchod kyi gnas yin pas bar chad mi byed/ 'o na phyogs skyong 'di rnams cha gsum nas phyag mchod kyi gnas/ sa chog gi dus su phur bus 'debs par 'dug pas 'gal lam snyam na ma yin te/ de'i 'khor na bgegs zhes pa de dang mi mthun pa re yod pas des bar chad byed pa'o/ phur bus 'debs/ /thabs kyi bsrung pa la'o/ /shes rab la mos 'jug gnyis te snga ma las ldog gzugs ston pa dang sgra brjod pa'i bar chad ni/ dbus pa jo gdan zhig gis bla chen grong pa'i khral skyel ba'i/ dbus pa'i dge bshes tshan zhig dang 'grogs nas 'ong / rong du slebs pa dang yon bdag cig gis nang mchod kyi rgyu phul/ cong zi'i phug cig tu mchod pa byas pas/ phug nas 'od dmar po zhig byung / 'dre yod dam bsam tsa na rnal 'byor ma rang gi sgom pa 'dra ba zhig byung / dga' ste phyag btsal mos gus byas pas/ khyod sa skyar 'gro'am zer/ 'gro lags byas pas/ ma 'gro bar chad 'ong skye med ston pa'i bla ma bde chen can song zer te mi snang par song / der nangs par sngar bas spyod pa 'gyur gzi brjid nas khong gi rting la byung / mi su 'phrad la de 'dri/ sa skyar mi 'gro zer zhing / yang rting la 'ong / kho nga la btsar gtol tsa na/ da mi 'gro na sa skya pha rgyab 'di ka na yod pas log cig

'gro na bla chen mi bzhugs kyang / slob dpon jo sras pa ngo mtshar ba bzhugs so byas pas/ yun ring zhig bsam nas/ lar 'gror mi 'dod pa zhig yod de da res 'gro ba las ma shes zer 'ong / sa skyar sleb da nyid rang mi mjal na bzhugs/ phyag rten med na sbyin byas pas/ 'dir 'ong nas mi mjal ba ga la mchis/ jo gdan gyi phyag rten 'dra ba sla zer mjal bas/ gral mgo na rje pa bzhugs pas khong gi kun spyod la mos 'dug der rje pa la rgyus mnga' ye byas pas/ med zer/ de nas khams pa srags ston bya ba 'dzam gling sum gnyis kyi mi'i rgyus yod zer ba gcig na re/ nga la rgyus yod zer bas/ zhwa phud thal mo sbyar nas zhus pas/ de spa tro stag tshang seṅge phug bya ba na yod zer bas thugs la btags zer/ 'di la rgyu mtshan zhig 'ong bsam rje pas thugs la bzung / der khos phyin pas de shi nas lo mang po lon zer/ shul na 'dug pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'dra la chos mnyan/ jo gdan zhig yur thog 'drar sham lhag 'dra 'thung / bro 'dra rtse/ de nas rje la mjal du 'ong / rje pa dkon khang bya ba na khams pas ja drangs yod pa'i dus su jo gdan zhig mjal zer bas/ ja ni 'dug yar bos gsungs bos pas/ sngar gyi der 'dug ste snam sbyar phyi na gyon/ zha la pho rog gi sgro zhig btsugs byung / rjes jo gdan gyi grub pa thob bam gsungs pas/ ma thob bya sngar khas blangs/ thob bya ru mkhas pa'i drung du dka' ba byung ste cha la bla ma sangs rgyas gcig dang mjal bas sems ngo 'phrod par byung lags kyi zer/ rjes bdag zer ba bzhin nyan gsungs pas/ dkar yol sa la bzhag thal mo sbyar ji skad gsungs pa nyan lags zer/ 'o na grub thob la che ba ston pa shākya thub pa'i rjes su rang bslab na mi 'chi'am/ sgro'ang jo gdan gyi mgo la mdzes rgyu med/ snam sbyar yang khyed rang la bgo ba'i gnas shig yod 'dug pa der gon pa 'thad gsungs pas/

rje pa ka rang re la mos phyogs re 'ong gi gda' zer bar chad kyis khyer ba bzhin no/ /lus brda'ang gos kyi phag tu ngag brda' yid kyi dris te/ de 'dres na gdon dang po ngag la 'jug pas so/ /rtsa ba'i brda' bdud kyi chen po zhig rang byung na mthus brjed pa'ang srid pas/ brda 'di rnams sgrub pa po la shin tu gces pas nub kyi dogs pa la/ yan lag 'di rnams lde theb lta bu yin gsungs/ gnas brtan bsod shes/ bla chen pa bar phug tu chos 'khor la byon dus phyin nas khrid zhus/ spe gog gcig tu bsgoms pas shākya thub pa byung / dga' ste 'di ltar byung zhus pas/ phal cher shākya thub min las che bas brda 'di rnams ston gsungs nas bslabs/ der srod la byung na dga' ste bsam pas byung / der brda gsum pa man chad bstan pas shes/ der yin pa la the tshom mi 'dug ste/ bzhi pa'ang ston snyam bstan pas seṅge chen por byas te shul rnams bse dris bkang mthong na yar song / rnying ma dga' bla chen min na nga bdud kyis khyer zin zer/ lte ba reg pa'i spe dkar yin bsam yas kyi nga gcig zer/ mtshan nyid pa kun na re/ de la thal 'gyur gcig btang bas chog zer te/ des mi thub/ dge bshes rngog la mchod gnas mnga' ris pa tsha mi gsol bya ba jo gdan pa shin tu btsun pa gcig yod/ khong gis bltas pas rngog lung pa'i phu nas byon tsa na spe dkar mda' na mar 'gro/ mda' nas byon tsa na kho phu na yar 'gro/ ci yin dris pas/ khong gi byang chub kyi sems kyi gzi brjid la mi bzod par 'dug zer/ khong sku khams ngan pas chang bag re gsol/ des bzi tsa na byang sems brjed 'gro bas der ngas phyin nas dpung pa la thal bcag na nges pa gsum gsum brgyab zer/ khong dpung pa snyung / tsha mi gsol gyi 'di ltar 'dug byas pas/ khyed mnga' ris pa tsha mi gsol/ nga rngog blo ldan shes rab tsam gyi bla mchod spe dkar gyi dbang du mi 'gro thang zer/

kho'ang gam na yod pas khyod rngog kyang sham pa phor gang gi dbang du mi 'gro thang zer gyin 'dug byas pas/ kho bden zer/ der tsha mi gsol gyis lo tsā byas te chos gtam byas pas/ phyi pa'i grub mtha' la kho cha chad kyi mkhas pa 'dug bye brag pa dang / mdo sde pa la'ang kho mkhas/ sems tsam la 'gres se tsam/ dbu ma la byas pas de phan chad chal chol yin zer/ yan lag gi ni/ bla chen gyi slob ma gshen re thul gyi byang phugs su/ brag phug cig tu bsgoms pas brag bar na mar rigs gsum mgon po tsa re na re byung / yan lag brda bstan pas ma shes bar chad du go de pa sa phyogs de'i the rangs spun gsum bya bar 'dug ste/ ming skya sangs/ sngo sbob/ gser zangs su btags te ci sgo ba nyan pa gcig byung ste shes rab kyi'o/ /grib kyi nges tshig yon tan gong ma la sgrib pas na'o/ /gdon grib ni 'dre brdungs sogs kyi skyon las 'byung ste/ des na dang po nas thub tshod mi byed par sbyang ba sogs byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin gsungs/ lha dang lha min gsang ba pa zhes pa'i gsang ba la 'dre yin pas so/ /rmi lam gyi gos rtags ni/ bla ma zhang la sbur chung sna leb/ zhang chung ma la byang pa tshwa tshong / rje pa la shig tu 'ong / sel grib chen po la tshul bla ma la dbang zhu/ gnyan a tsa ra dpal dbyangs la/ spyi spyod bzhengs mkhan 'bro tsha byang chub kyis ngo chen byas nas mo'i ming po 'gro ko sha bya ba'i sdig can gcig la dbang bskur byas pa'i dam tshig gi grib der khyi lam rdza mo bya bar kho rang gi lugs kyi tshogs mchod brgya rtsa byas pas/ yi dam gyi lha pra mo ha bya ba'i zhal mthong / rigs kyi bu khyod rang gi brtson 'grus yin na/ re zhig sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa yin gsungs/ des na 'bring la dam can gyi grogs mched la cho ga sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis tshogs 'khor bya/

tsha tsha'ang lto 'phye brtags pa blangs/ 'jim pa'i byin rlabs/ bhi bhi'i sngags don gsal bzhin la rab gnas bsdus pa bya'o/ /dam tshig bshags pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsal lo/ /bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge zhes bgyi ba la dam tshig nyes pa 'di lta bu zhig byung ste nyes pa de rdo rje 'dzin pa'i drung du mthol lo bshags so/ /mthol zhing bshags na bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyis/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so/ /zhes lan gsum byas pa'i mthong sdom yang dri/ sbyin sreg la me bsang sbyang bya/ mi bskyod pa khros pa/ ba spu gyen du langs pa/ gzhan dkyus na/ rang lhar zer yang sdig sbyong la tha mal 'thad zer/ rkang mthil gyi rlung gis sum mdo'i me bskul des brdas nas sna sgor sdig pa ra can sogs srog chags yid du mi 'ong pa'i rnam par gyur nas til la thim pa de g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du phul bar bsam zhing grangs mi bzung zer yang / nar ma la bzung yang mi 'gal lo/ /sngags shan+tiṃ zhi ba/ bha smin thal ba yin pas phyi ma 'thad/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ 'di la 'phros nas sbyin sreg rgyas pa chos bco brgyad kyi nyams su blang ba logs na yod do/ /thig le bsrung ba bar pa la zer yang / dang po la'ang shin tu gces/ me tog dang dri bzhin du de lus la mi gnas na yon tan mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gong du song / 'khor 'das thun mong gi 'jug 'dir/ chos rje pa 'di ltar gsungs/ ngas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bsam nas 'bad pa chen pos chos kyi rnam gzhag byas/ chos la rang bzo ye ma byas/ rje'i gsung gis/ gang byed kyang cho gar 'gro ba gcig dgos yang yang gsung ba la/ dang po ma go phyis bsams pas mad par 'dug de'ang dang po sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ de'i don bstan bcos mkhan po dang / grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis bkral/

phyag len de'i don bla ma dam pa'i thugs su chud pa'i bzhin byed pa zhig 'dug na cho ga bya ba yin/ yang rje'i zhal nas/ nga stong nyid la kha bsri dgos pa byung gsungs/ de med thabs dang bral ba'i stong nyid bskyangs pa des khar rje che na nyan rang / chung na gzugs med/ nyes na dud 'gro'i rgyu byed gsungs ngas khyod tsho la yang yang de skad byas kyang / phyis bro pa'i rtsi rtsi gtong ba 'dra ba zhig 'ong ste/ dang po sru mo zhang / tsha'o brtsegs so/ zhang g.yu reg sogs sna tshogs shig bstan nas ltad mo che sgang la yu dpon po bya ba zhig gis phyag nas ko rtse'i nang du ja la byon zer nas 'gro /de nas mgo gug lan gsum byas nas/ stib po sdod cig ltad mo che po da gzod 'ong zer yang ci yang 'ong rgyu med/ de bzhin du ngas kyang khyed tsho la nyan rang / byang sems gsang sngags kyi rang rang gi gzhung lugs dang mi 'gal bar lag len gyi sngags pa yin byas nas 'og ma'i bcas pa la khyad gsod byas na mi 'thad pas med pa gal che/ cho ga zab mo'i dus su gnang ba la the tshom med pa de las gzhan du bcas pa la khyad gsod med pa gcig dgos/ mdor na blang dor gyi dmigs legs por phyed pa gcig dgos byas kyang / ltad mo che sgang la chags pa dang 'dra bar/ de tsho tshig gi na ya yin/ stong nyid kyi don gcig rtogs pas chog zer nas med par lta ba re la kha lhan song ba re 'ong gsungs/ khrid lugs kyi skabs su/ dper na rgya mtsho nas nor bu 'don pa la gzings dang / dung dang / bya rog sogs sna tshogs gcig yod pa la/ gtso bor ded dpon smos pa de bzhin du sangs rgya ba la thabs sna tshogs shig yod kyang rlung smos so/ /yi ges khrid pa ni/ 'dus pa dang po la ma nges pa 'khrul snang sogs thog du 'gro ba bag re phal cher mi 'gro /bar pa la phyed 'gro phyed mi 'gro /tha ma la mi 'gro ba mi srid tsam/ phal cher 'gro

/gsum po 'di yang thog mar rlung / de nas gzhan gnyis kyis khrid pa lta bu min/ 'o na ji ltar na rlung gnod pa skyel ba/ khams ma dwangs pa/ yi ge phal pa ma nges pa 'khrul snang du 'char ba'i yi ge lam khrid pa gsum dus mnyam zhing gnad gcig gzhan des 'gre spyi don no/ /tshogs lam phan yon dang bcas pa ni/ spyir tshogs sbyor gnyis 'gre zhing skye ste lam snga ma snga ma tshogs lam/ phyi ma phyi ma sbyor lam mo/ /bskyed rim lta bu la'ang gnas grogs kha zas yid dang mthun pa sogs tshogs lam/ de la brten bskyed rim las sems zin pa sbyor lam mo/ /'o na 'das pa la'ang de bzhin rung ngam zhe na/ rung mthun brtsis na nyan te/ chos spyi skad bstun nas 'jig rten pa la rtsi/ tshogs lam dang po ni bum dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig gis ya tha tshogs zhing spyan drangs ba sogs dkyus na'o/ /'bras bu bzhi'i bral 'bras ni/ rta nag pa nags bsgom bsod nams rgyal mtshan byis pa'i dus su 'khyams/ gung thang du zangs gyang phu pa bya ba gshin rje gshed rlan mtsho dmar po'i bya ba byed pa'i dge bshes shig gis ba glang 'tshos/ der gyer bsgom gyis lad mo byas pas/ ci zhig tsa na ba glang rnams gshin rje gshed du mthong / sgra thams cad hriḥṣir+ṭa thos/ 'di ltar byung byas pas/ las 'phro yod pa yin zer/ phyis bla chen la dbang dang gdams ngag zhus pas sgom chen bzang po zhig byung skad/ de bral 'bras la'o/ /rta nag pa nags bsgom bsod nams rgyal mtshan la byung pa lta bu'o/ /rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu na/ zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ tshe thog med nas rang gi kun gzhi la rigs drug gi bag chags yod pa de bsgom pa sad nas/ rigs drug gi skad go ba dang sgra shes pa 'ong bas so/ /khams pa ldan bus bar phug tu bsgoms pas/ 'jol mo gcig na re/ ldan bu 'gro re ran zer gyin phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed/ der phyir bud pa dang gad phug ser kha shig shig byung nas zhig
