yang bo dong du/ rdza thul dug can gyi slob dpon 'dar bsgom nag po bya ba thos bsam tsam ma byas/ rdza'i bdud rtsi'i tshigs gsum bya ba mi rtog pa gcig bsgoms pas dud 'gro'i skad shes te/ nyin cig mchil pa gcig ci cig zer bas 'dzum byed/ ci lags zhus pas/ 'u cag la zho skyel mi zhig 'ong lo zer/ ku re ma lags sam byas pas/ kho bo la rdzun bya don med zer/ dar cig nas yon bdag mo sgron ne bya bas zho rdza'u gang bskyal song yang khong la ba gcig yod pa skye ba snga ma'i ma yin pas de dang gtam bag re byas/ de gzhan la smras pas/ ba na re/ khyod gzhan la smra yi 'dug zer nas smrar ma 'dod/ rgyu mthun mang chung ma sdug bsngal gyi rkyen gyis kyang bde ba'i grogs byed pa lta bu'o/ /dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu la zhu yas kyis sprul pa bstan pa sogs zhib tu gsungs nas skabs don khong chos brgyad kyi rtog pa chung ste/ zhwa la bud med kyi sham bu'i dum bu rlon mo/ rin po che pa 'bras bu bzhi'i cha da lta nas 'ong ste/ skabs skabs su snang snang thams cad lha yin snyam pa byed/ sgra thams cad sngags/ sems mi rtog pa'i ngang du 'gro ba snyam byed pa ni bral 'bras kyi cha mthun/ de bzhin du de ring 'di 'dra zhig 'ong snyam tsa na 'byung ba ni gnyis pa/ 'jig rten blos btang gi bsgom chen nam/ de bas skyid pa yod de snyam pa ni gsum pa/ da nga la chos brgyad kyi rtog pa gang gis kyang brdzi bar mi nus snyam pa ni bzhi po'i cha mthun yin gsungs/ las 'phro ni skye ba snga ma sgom byed 'phro la shi na/ tshe 'dir rkyen bag tsam gyis rang gi ngang gis khams 'dus te/ stod mo rdo rje mtsho bzhin no/ /mos gus ni bsod nams bsags na nges par sangs rgyas rang du 'dug snyam pa skyes na 'du ste brad mo dkon ne bzhin no/ /'o cag la rab na dbang zhus pa'i bla ma yin/ mos gus bya dgos snyam pa tsam 'byung ste des 'du mi nus/

brtson 'grus ni thun bzhi sogs 'bad rtsol drag po dgos te/ de yang 'jug sel du 'gro ba zhig dgos/ sems yengs na 'du mi nus gsungs/ phyogs med kyi don las 'phro ma nges par sad pa ste/ rgal bub pa sogs kyis kyang 'du/ dam pa rgya gar gyis bsod nams bsags pa'i mi la sgom gtad med du skye bar gda' gsungs/ mos gus kyang ma log lta log tu byas pa'am/ brtson 'grus kyang nyin mtshan ngo mi shes par byas pa la zer/ bdun gyi dang po rgyu/ bar ba rnams ngo bo/ tha ma 'bras bu zer ba la rgyur 'gyur bas dpyad/ gzhan yul rkyen sna tshogs kyi 'du ba ni/ bla chen gyis sger bu kha mo za dur du chos 'khor la byon pa'i drung du/ zhang po ston pa sogs kyang 'gro bar zhu zer phyin/ der khong bzi nas yon bdag gi sgo bcag mar log nas bla ma zhang gi ma cig na re/ chos 'khor bzang ngam/ yon bdag dad dam zer/ chos 'khor bzang / yon bdag rang dad dam ma dad dam nged bzi nas sgo rag rug tu bcag zer bas/ cha la sems can skyon gyi rang bzhin du gda' ba zer sgom du song ba bzhin no/ /byang chub kyi phyogs 'di rnams phar phyin dang ming mthun yang / don bag tsam mi mthun/ go rim yang mi 'dra ste phar phyin pa sems la gnad du bsnun pas lam bul bas dran pa nyer bzhag nas/ 'di pa lus la gnad du bsnun pas myur te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa nas te dkyus na/ khams 'dus pa dang po zhes pa la/ 'du sa gang du 'du na/ sna tshogs 'dud rtsogs 'dir sbyor/ de me sbor ba sogs bya ba sna tshogs byed pas so/ /mdud pa ni lte ba'i rtsa 'dab kyi lte ba nam mkha' stong pa e gru gsum gyi rnam par yod/ snying kha rten gyi ni sems kyi rten hūm̐ bam̐ gyi mgrin pa longs spyod ni ro sna tshogs la longs spyod ma'i/ spyi bo mi shigs pa'i ni me sbor ba sogs kyis mi shigs pa ste ya'i rnam par yod de 'du sa'o/

/bcos thabs kyi la dor la/ 'o na khyod kyi la dor gsum po 'di sngar yang byung ba 'di rnams gsal ba nus so na/ nus te yug yug mkhan gyi lag bca' bzhin no/ /lhag pa'i lha'i ni/ 'ga' zhig bla ma bas yi dam ngos la mos pa 'ong ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la gsang 'dus la dka' ba'i gnas bco brgyad byung / khong rang gi slob dpon bha li ta pa la dris kyang / bla ma'ang de skad gsungs zer ma shes/ der glegs bam mgul btags byas te lho phyogs su 'tshol du byon pa'i lam kha na thang chen po zhig gis dbus na bud med cig thags 'thag de'i gam na ban btsun cig chos gos la thod byas/ zhing rmod cing 'og gi srog chags steng du steng gi 'og tu sbed pa zhig 'dug de la chos ston blangs pas/ bud med la zob la drongs zer/ der 'bras btsos lab ti bya ba'i shing lo gcig khar bzhag bcos ma'i rdzing nas lcags kyus nya bzung nas bsad de'i khar bzhag khyi mo zhig la skyugs shig gi brda byas bskyugs/ de tsho drangs pas/ nga dge slong yin/ nya dang khyi mo'i skyugs pa mi za byas pas/ 'o na gzod cig drongs zer/ der snod bkrus g.yos te drangs pas gsol/ der 'gro bar chas pa la/ do nub sleb sa na yul med/ gcan gzan 'ong 'dir sdod zer der shing sdong zhig gi tsar gsang 'dus la zhal 'don byas pas/ bud med de dka' ba'i gnad re la blo mi bde ba'i rnam 'gyur byed kyi 'dug 'dis shes sam/ phyag byas zhus pas ngas mi shes zer/ khyod rnam 'gyur de ltar byed pa ci yin byas pas/ de khyod kyis mi shes pa tsam du ngas kyang go zer/ 'o na sus shes byas pas ban btsun des zer/ gar song byas pas nyo chang la'o/ /nam 'ong byas pas da lta 'ong zer/ khong 'khyor yin byung ste zhus pas/ dbang dgos zer/ sngar ba li ta pa la zhus byas pas nga rang gi dgos zer/ der dkyil 'khor gyi khang par lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas/

da nga la'am/ dkyil 'khor la zhu gsungs/ slob dpon dang da rung mjal yong snyam nas dkyil 'khor la zhu byas pas des dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur nas nam mkhar 'ja' yal ba bzhin thal/ slob dpon la dbang yon phul bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor la zhus pas nga mi 'dod gsungs/ nyid drin che bas 'bul byas pas/ 'o na nga nam mthong tsa na phyag gsum gsum phul gsungs pas/ de bzhin khas blangs/ lar khyod kyis 'khrul pa chen gcig byas/ khyi mo'i skyugs pa de zos na tshe 'dir phyag chen thob pa yin pa la/ dkyil 'khor yang ngas sprul pas nga ngos bzang ste ma zhus pas/ tshe 'di la mgo la me 'bar ba gsod pa'i brtson 'grus byas kyang phyag chen mi thob/ bar dor gsungs/ de'i don 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ khyod kyang zas kyi bya ba la/ /nga la'ang cung zad 'khrul rtog pas/ /gzugs kyi phung po rang lus 'dis/ /tshe 'dir dngos grub mi thob ste/ /yid ni rdo rje'i skur gyur nas/ /bar dor yang dag 'grub par 'gyur/ /gsungs nas dka' gnad tsho dkrol/ da khyod yul dbus su song la bshad pa gyis gsungs nas mi snang bar gshegs/ me tog dman ma tho ri byas 'dug ste/ slob dpon de 'jam dpal grags pa bya ba yin/ de nas slob dpon rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi dbus na chos ston cing yod tsa na/ yang slob dpon byon/ phyag 'tshal rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis brnyas kyi dogs nas ma mthong pa bzhin byas/ chos thon pa dang khong gi rjes su phyin pas/ rgya gar na mchod rten gyi grib ma la sdod pa ngan par byed kyang / khong grib ma la nyal 'dug phyag byas pas da ci mi byed pa ci yin gsungs/ ma mthong lags byas pas/ mthong bzhin de skad zer ba sa'i snying po gha tsha gsungs pas mig gnyis sa la lhung / der ye shes kyi spyan gcig snang bas ye shes spyan zhes grags so/ /mdo rgyud zab mo'i ni/ snya nam pa'i ston pa zhig la khams 'dus byung nas/

mi dga' zhing yig yug pa'i snang ba byung ste lceb bsam nas brag 'phrang zhig na phar phyin pas 'jigs kyi 'dug ci la 'jigs bsam pas/ 'gril kyis dogs/ ci la 'gro bsam pas lceb tu/ der dran pas cung zad zin pas/ mdo na de ma nyes pa ci 'dug blta bsam bltas pas/ yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ston pa zhig dang mjal ste khams drag de la chos rje pa na re/ dper na mi bong bur bsgyur ba la mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs sngags 'jig pa'i tswa zos pas mir 'gyur ba bzhin gsungs/ rten 'brel ni 'phrin las kyi mi tshad gegs sel kun 'dir 'jug gsungs/ yan lag gi rlung rim gyi 'gag pa ni rlung rang bzhin log na mig long ba sogs kyi skyon 'ong / bsgoms pas log na ting nge 'dzin skye/ thig le 'dus pas mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa'ang / dwangs ma mi gnas na sha khrag gi gtor ma sogs phul yang byin gyis mi rlob/ de ma nyams na phyi'i mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlob pa rten 'brel gyi che ba yin/ sku mnyen lcug ni/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong sa la btsugs nas bskor ba kun yang 'di lta bu'i rten 'brel byung gsungs/ khams gsum kun tu snang ba ni/ 'dus pa gsum la sbyar te/ dang po la rnam rtog sngon song gi mthong snang / rmi lam nyams gsum snang / gnyis po des 'gre /du ba ni bsgom du ma zad nan tan drag po las kyang 'byung ste/ 'jad pa ston skyabs kyi grwa pa zhig la du snang byung / slob dpon la zhus pas cha med 'og gdon gnod pa min nam zer/ der gru la bstan pas klu'i brlangs bya ba shin tu thu ba yin zer/ bzlas pa phog nas lo gcig bzlas so/ de nas blta zer/ de ltar byas pas smin ma byi/ gzer mgo byung / de nas bstan pas mi zlogs/ der rje pa mkhas zer/ de la 'phros nas don zhags las a rak+ṣa mam sa bha liṃ ta ces pa la khrag med pa'i gtor ma sha dang bcas pa zer te nor/

dgag tshig spel ma shes/ sha khrag med pa'i bya bar 'ong gsungs/ der rje la zhus pas/ nged ni sgom du'ang byed/ dbang zhig zhus na bsal ba la tshags med gsungs/ dbang zhus/ dmigs pa cig bstan pas sangs drag da nyid rang sngar gyi chos 'phro nyan na'ang nyon gsungs pas/ go ba bag tsam ni bdog sgom byed zer bsgoms pas bzang po zhig byung / dmigs sgyu byung na shin tu so mi gsod pa zhig 'ong ste/ bum pa lta bu la bltas na 'dar/ de nas ri khang khyim sogs gang la bltas kyang 'dar ba 'byung gsungs/ me rlung gi gzhan thams cad dbang byas pa ni/ chos rje pa dper na yod pa chu ja yod kyang tshwa ches pas ja tshwa'i rang bzhin du 'dug zer ba bzhin gsungs/ chu'i ni spyan mnga' ba la gcan gzan gyi lpags pa g.yogs/ rgyun du khri'i 'og tu sol me bzhag 'bol mang po brtsegs kyang 'jam pa las mi 'ong ste/ slob ma kun na re/ lha sar klu dmar gro gzi chen dang 'phrad pas nyes zer 'di pa khong thugs dam rem pas chu rlung gi nyams su byed/ sa'i ni khab sor btsun ma gcig la/ dang po gser gyi sa gzhi mthong pas dga'/ de nas lus lci ba/ mthe chung bsgul ba dang ri rab khyad med snyam pa byung nas lus 'khrugs su song nas shi lha mo sna tshogs ni sa rlung sogs zin pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ spyan ma sogs kyis gtso byas pa'i lha sna tshogs kyi mchod pa byed pas/ thos chung nga rgyal skye ste 'di rnams kyang mchod na mi 'di rnams kyang nga chos pa tsam du yang ma mthong 'dug snyam pa'o/ /'byung chung bcu drug tu cha mnyam zhes pa ni/ spyir nyin zhag gcig la rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu/ 'pho ba bcu gnyis ltar na/ 'pho ba gcig la rlung stong brgyad brgya ba gcig kyang zer/ dgu brgya phrag gnyis kyang zer/ 'pho ba gnyis la 'byung chung bcu drug 'ong / de'ang thog mar rlung rags pa nas zin 'ong bas/ 'gag rim dang bstun na/

g.yas nas sa rlung dang chu rlung dgu brgya pa phrag re rgyu/ bskyed rim dang bstun nas g.yon nas rlung gi dang me'i de tsam re rgyu ste mgon po'i rlung ngo / /de la nang pas lha mo'i nyis brgya pa nyer lnga pa bzhi bzhi ste/ 'byung chung bcu drug go /dri ro ni/ nang du chu'i rlung zin pa'i rten 'brel te/ mu stegs kyis dri sa ro chu'i yon tan zhes pa'i don no/ /bdud rtsi lnga rab 'bring tha mar cha mnyam pa ni/ rab dwangs pa/ tha ma ma dwangs pa/ 'bring cung zad dwangs pa'o/ /de'i nyams la'ang gdul bya dang mthun pa'i snang ba 'byung ste/ kyai rdo rje'i gdul bya la zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ de bzhin du bde mchog la sogs pa la'ang 'gre /'bring de'i rigs mi bskyod pa la/ phyag rdor gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur sogs/ rnam snang la gshin rje gshed sogs/ rin 'byung la nam mkha'i snying sogs/ 'od dpag med la spyan ras gzigs sogs/ don grub la sgrib pa rnam sel sogs 'byung ngo / /thig phran ni mang gyur bsgom pa jo lcags kyis byang du bsgom du phyin pas phug nas skar ma byung / 'dre yin snyam ste gzhan du phyin yang byung / 'brog gseb tu phyin pas sbra'i tshugs shing las kyang byung / des sa skyar 'ong bla chen la zhus pas/ khyod rang bsgom gyi bye brag yin gsungs/ yang rje'i slob ma zhig gis lha mtsho srin mtsho'i 'gram du bsgoms pas/ mtsho nas skar ma byung / de gnyan pas 'dre yin bsam/ rje la zhus pas sngar bzhin/ rtsa 'dzin ni gsung la ro rkyang la rtsa bran gzhan gyis dang / dbu ma la de gnyis kyis gcer ba'o/ /'di dge bshes snyag la byung / ji byas kyang ma phan/ der ma 'ongs pa ni rdo rje'i lus skyon med gcig la smon lam gdab pa las 'os med zer sgom bshol/ aṃ yig las ser sna ni rga lo la byung ste/ khong khams pa a tshangs pa bya ba skye sa can yin/ der dal 'byor don yod par bya bsam ste dbus gtsang na bstan pa yod zer 'ong bas/

de dus na sha ra ba grags pa che bas gdam ngag zhus pa mi rtag pa bstan/ de go nas chos byed pa yin/ de bas zab pa med dam byas pas med zer/ chos rje pa na re/ bshad pa byed tsa na shes rab can sgrog tu mi gzhug dad pa can g.yang la mi skyur ba'i 'ud yod de/ sga lo la bdag gzhan brje ba'i bdag med bsgom pa lta bu ston thang gsungs/ der gtsang pa'i gang drag pa kun yang 'di na 'dug pas/ de na'ang med nges snyam rgya gar du phyin nyang stod pa tsā mi lo tsa ba dang mjal/ khong yang bod byung pas mnyes 'dir sdod ngas chos dang 'tsho ba gnyis ka bya zer/ bod mnyam po la nyan pa mi 'ong snyam paṇ+ḍi ta gcig la bsam phyin pas/ rgya gar na su mkhas dris pas/ a bh+ya mkhas zer/ der 'gro bsam pas paṇ+ḍi ta gcig 'do li la bteg byung / su yin dris pas a bh+ya zer/ gar bzhud dris pas/ rtsa mi la chos nyan du zer/ der mi phan 'dug bsam dbang zhus dus 'khor tshar gcig gsan/ rdo rje gdan gyi lcong khang du sbyor drug bsgoms te/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor rdzogs/ mthong lam skye la khad song ba dang / 'jim los kyal ka byas sga chung pa byas pas skad ma byung / khyod de skad mi ster 'dug ste ma ga dha thams cad du ru gas khengs/ de thams cad 'bros kyin yod do byas pas/ snying sngangs te nga 'bro sgo phye zer bas ku re yin byas kyang ma lo/ rtsa mis khyod rang kha 'gras pa'i ku re yin/ 'jigs na nged kyis kyang chos 'dir bshad kyi bar chad yin sdod byas pas/ bar du bcad zin nga'i snying 'gas par 'dug sgo phye zer sgo brdungs/ der smyo nas rtsa mi dpon po mi sod la bkod/ dgong zhig bros bdas pas ma zin/ nangs par btsal lha khang zhig na dbang phyug gi rten gyi phrag gong na sgom du song 'dug ci yin byas pas mdang 'dir 'ong 'dug 'jigs pa snyam byed/ der 'jigs rgyu med/ 'jig rten na che ba dbang phyug yin te nga'i yi dam dus 'khor gyi gdan na yod pa yin snyam 'dzegs pas 'dir thar/

sgom du song 'dug zer/ de nas rgya gar na gdam ngag su che zer ba la dris kyang ma phan/ rtsa mi na re/ da khyod kyi 'di la rgya gar na ni phan pa mi 'dug bod na bla ma sa skya pa bya ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gdam ngag la mkhas pa zhig yod par 'dug pas song zer bas/ der khams 'dus par song bas rgyags dang go lag ci yang med par da kha la zangs yong / skyid grong sleb sleb grang ba yang ma tshor/ der bod rims nad kyis shi ba'i ra lcog cig gyon nas na la rtser bla chen dang mjal zer/ da lta sku mtshams la bzhugs mi mjal byas pas/ gzhan dang mi mjal yang nga dang mjal ba zhig yin gyis zer/ sgo srung brdungs nang du shor te sgo nang nas mnan nas/ khyod bla ma sa skya pa chen po yin nam byas pas yin gsungs pas/ der dang po chos la 'ong lugs/ rgya gar du phyin pa/ khams 'dus byung tshul sogs bshad nas gegs sel zhu byas pas/ dbang ni rtsa mis bskur/ de ma thag gdam ngag bsgoms pas/ sngar gyi sgom gyi rlan yod pa dang snying rus che bas dmigs pa lan gcig gnyis rang gis sangs drag der brgyad stong pa zhig spyi bor bzhag nas ma dgag pa'i mna' zhig bskyal/ rgya bod gnyis na khyod las gdam ngag che ba yod re zer/ da khyod la yon tan zhig skye bas rtsa mi can song la sgoms gsungs pas/ de tsa na sos ka yin pas tshad pa byung gis dogs nas dgun 'gro snyam tsa na/ grub thob kyi grags pa chen po byung / chag stod dang 'brog pas spyan drangs pas/ der rgyud nas dbus kyi byang rgyab tu lhan song / sha ra ba dang mjal bas bka' bkyon byung / dkar yol sa la brdabs pas gral gang gi ja phor sa la lhungs/ de nas khams su byon longs spyod chen po byung yang / ja mdog 'gyur tsam grangs na/ 'dis mdzo sked bcag bcag pa yin 'di 'dra ma byed zer bka' bkyon byung ngo / /gsol yang mi nus/ ster yang mi nus/ g.yog po mdzod du 'gro na gos med par gtong ste/

'ga' zhig bsgoms pas thur song zer/ 'ga' zhig rten 'brel yod pa yin zer te/ gnyis ka min/ am̐ yig tu 'dus pa'i rten 'brel lo/ /nyam nga ni sha ra ba la byung ste 'khor mang pos bskor yang gcig langs pa'i dod du gcig ma bzhag na cig zing 'ong pa snyam byed pa 'byung ste 'ga' zhig gsang 'dus kyi 'gyur bcos pas lan zer/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs sad na/ dngos grub rab mchog thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa la de bzhin gshegs la tshogs bsags su bsgyur bas lan zer/ kha cig shor po sta ri zer ba'i btsan gcig dang thug pas lan zer/ kha cig sga lo dang dam tshig gi sel byung pas zer te/ de tsho min nyams nga'i rtsar 'dus pa'i nyams snang ngo / /yang sgom chen zhig gis bum pa gcig gi nang du nyal bas nam phyed na seṅge lnga byung / rdo tho gcig gis brdungs pas song / nangs par rigs lnga sku brdungs 'dug yi ge lngar 'dus na nyams nga 'ong zhes pa la'o/ /mya ngan ni khab sor ma jo cig mi shi tshad kyi ming nas 'bod cing ngu ste/ dbus su jo bo lha chen nam bya ba shi zer bas/ jo bo lha chen zer nas ngu / 'dre snang ni ra sar bon po gcig la byung ste/ ag khro bsnyen pa sogs byas kyang ma phan/ rje pa la rnam rgyal sgang du mjal 'di ltar byung byas pas/ lar nyid cag rang sngags pa chen po yin te/ bka' tha dad yin pas dbang zhig ni zhu 'tshal phan ni phan mchis gsungs pas/ gtam zer 'phro la rje pa 'dre byung ngo zer/ aṣ+ṭa zlos shig dzam dzam kha lad lad byed/ de nas nyal song / ji ltar byung byas pas/ 'dre mtheb rdog tsam go bkad du byung nas gos la 'dzegs/ spyi brtol che ba kun gyis 'khur ba phug nas lce thog tu bro 'khrab/ de slad pa lags zer/ rje pas gsan pas chu sgra shwa zer/ chos rje pa da ltar gyi snang pa thams cad 'di dang 'dra zer/ rje pas da myur du byon lus 'khrugs su 'gro nyen yod gsungs pas/

slob ma kun na re/ de bas rang re 'dra brdungs dang mtshams bcad drag zer byas te mi phan shi gsungs/ yang mang mkhar jo sras 'od 'bar 'jang pa ston skyabs kyi shes rab can zhig yin te la la 'dre snang byung / zhu don mo ri pa can phyin zhus pas/ sngar ci byas zer/ 'dre brdungs 'dra byas zhus pas/ khong sems can thams cad ma yin pa la dgongs nas ai ma byung 'dug pas khams 'dus pa'i stobs kyis/ cho ma cig nyes bsam te khams 'dus/ der yi ge drug ma'i sgom zhig phog nas ma ṇi bgrong byas pas/ ma zin/ nangs par khams dris pa thur song zer/ mdang gi de bsgoms sam byas pas ma zin zer/ shes rab can gyis mi zin pa mi srid/ yid ma ches pa yin bsam ste/ de gnyis la khyed med bsgom bzlas mdzod byas pas/ khyed med dam zer/ med byas pas/ 'o na mi shes pa'i yi ge drug ma dang ma ṇi bas shes pa'i he ru ka dang / ru lu bzla zer der nyid rang song la phan/ de la 'dre snang ni/ mang mkhar gyi mda' na yar 'tshub ma'i gseb na bud med nag mo dre'u la bzhon pa pang na spre'u thogs pa zhig khang rtsar 'ongs nas spre'u khang thog tu bskyur de skas la babs kho'i phrag gong du bzhon nas byad la bltar 'ong / nam langs pa dang pang du mchongs te mda' na mar 'gro/ der lus 'khrugs su song / bha ga'i yi ge'i gnas sogs ni/ rna rtsa phyi shun sogs gsung la ni byon/ 'o na ji lta na lte ba man chad rtsa gsum so sor gyes pa'i g.yas la yas rim gyis gsum/ g.yon la bzhi ste lus kyi g.yon gnyan pa'ang yi ge mang bas so/ /dbu ma la bdun/ phyi shun sogs mi 'thad de/ rtsa yig gnyis tha dad min pas so/ /ci ste na rtsa 'khyogs pa nyid yi ge'i rnam par yod pas so gsungs/ gnas brtan bsod shes lhar skyes pa snyam byed pas/ gzhan la dbu rgyan 'dug khong la mi 'dug pas ngo tsha nas/ rgad po gcig la dris pas/ khyod btsun chung tsa na rtsa brgyad kyi dbu la 'goms pas nyes zer bsams pas de bzhin byas 'dug

phyis rgyu 'bras la shin tu 'dzem pa zhig byung ste/ 'khor ba'i nyams la brten nas log lta spongs zhes pa'i don no/ /yi dwags ni/ sa skyar jo bo zhig la nor mang po yod kyang za mi nus/ zas skom kho na'i gtam zer/ bza' rgyu ni 'dug zo byas pas/ de bdag yi dwags mchu bcings bya ba yin zer/ dud 'gro'i ni/ bsgom pa 'od grags kyi sa skya'i 'phreng lam du bsgoms pas/ byang kha rtsa shor po skye ba'i thang la lug khyu yod pa'i lu gu zhig tu skyes/ der ma'i phyi la 'gro yis yod tsa na/ char byung rgyab bangs pas ma bde/ der rta pa gcig lug rdzi dang gros byas/ lug khyu phar ded tshur ded byas kho bzung sbra zhig na nad ma zhig 'dug pa'i sar khyer/ bon po zhig gi spu gtogs 'phyar 'phyar gcig byas ma'i rtsar bskyal/ yang zhag 'ga' na rta pa re byung / nga 'dzin du 'ong snyam 'jigs te bros kyang ma thar sngar kyi sar khyer/ nad ma rngum zhum byas thur song 'dug der lu gu yas rtags su btags/ gsus pa la gri sob brgyab pas nga bsad snyam pa zhig byung pa dang sgom sad/ rgyab mi bde ba de sa la 'gyel bas so/ /yang g.yag lung du jo mo zhig snga mor langs te/ gyang khar phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed cing khyi skad 'don/ de 'dra ma byed byas pas/ de nga jo mo 'a 'u bya ba yin zer/ gzhan yang mang chung ma ko ko g.yag tu skyes pa sogs gsungs ngo / /dmyal ba'i ni/ bla chen gung thang na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ dbus pa'i jo gdan dbal ngan gcig byung / nad gzhi yod de/ yod na ngas sman dpyad byas gsungs pas/ drung gi mi rnams bskrad nas/ bdag bsod nams ma bsags pa gcig lags zer/ ma bsags rgyu yod de/ dal 'byor ni thob chos dang 'phrad/ de nas kyang jo gdan du gda' ba gsungs pas/ de bdag la dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal chen po yod zer/ ji ltar 'ong gsungs pas/ mdun 'dir bu ga nang sang ba zhig 'ong / de na mar bltas pas lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi dmar rjen rjen mthong /

ma lhungs na dga' ste bsam tsa na spyi gtsug tu lhung nas sdug bsngal chen po 'ong / de mang na nyin re la lan gsum/ ji ltar yang lan re 'ong / de rdo rje gdan la phyin la bskor ba 'dra byas na bsam/ bla chen gyis nged ni de la sgom du'ang byed/ dbang gcig zhus na bsal ba la tshegs med gsungs pas/ 'o na zhu/ rgya gar du'ang thabs chag nas 'gro ba lags zhus pas/ dbang bskur nas de re zhig skye ru ka chug gsungs pas/ thabs bdog na 'di skad rang zhu zer/ dmigs pa bstan dgos kyi yi ge rang sa nas ston pa bsgoms pas de sel nas bsgom chen bzang po gcig byung / gzhan yang bsgom pa 'od grags kyis bsgoms pas mtshor lhung pa'i gtam rgyud gsung ngo / nor yod kyang bza' mi nus/ ster mi nus pas de yi dwags kyi don med kyi sdug bsngal mang po byed pa 'ong ste dmyal ba'i 'o/ /des gzhan yang 'gre /gnas sbyong 'di rnams ma tshor bar 'ong gi 'dug go /rtog spyod ni tsher ma rno ba sran ma zlum pa sogs kyi bsam mno byed pa'o/ /yum shes phyin kyi sogs khongs su/ kyai rdo rje'i ltar na bdag med ma de bzhin du phag mo/ reg bya rdo rje ma sogs mang po bsdu'o/ /bsam gtan dang po'i nyams skyes bsgom chen de rtog spyod shin tu rem pa zhig 'ong ste/ sngar 'dus pa dang po la yi ge phal pa sogs kyi lam khrid pa rim pa ltar sbyar ba dang / 'dir dang po la yi ge bcu bzhi byung bas/ sa bcad bag 'grig par snang gsungs/ mdor bsdus rgyas bshad ni/ spyir phyi rol tu ci snang ba thams cad kun gzhi la bag chags su yod/ de'i rten lus la rtsa yig tu yod/ der rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis snang ba 'byung ste/ dper na nga lta bu chos bshad sogs yang de'i rten 'brel du go dgos gsungs/ rak+ṣa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab la yi ge bsam gyis mi khyab pas lam khrid pa la sbyor gsungs/

bshad kyis mi lang ba mdor bsdus nas rgyas bshad la sbyar na legs gsungs/ bshad kyis mi lang de dper na lung pa bzang pa gcig na rtswa sna tshogs yod pa la re re nas bgrang gis mi lang ba la rtswa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dug zer ba bzhin/ yi ge bsam gyis mi khyab par rlung sems 'dus pas nyams bsam gyis mi khyab par 'byung ba'i don no gsungs/ lnga ni lam lnga la gnas pa'i nyan rang dang bcu ni sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' byams pa lta bu la'ang gsang gsungs/ byang chub chen po'i rten 'brel ni/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu nyams skyon med gsum la'ang sbyar du nyan/ shes shing ni thos chung gis/ shes pa ni bsam byung / bsgom byung gi gsungs/ go lugs la phyi rol la re rtsol mi dgos par go yang / las dang po pas re dogs/ dper na dpal mgor btsan la grogs po ne tso gcig yod pa khras khyer bas/ kho na re bsod de zer bas de la ma re ba sprad sprad gyis zer/ de bzhin du don la sbyar bas shes/ dogs pa dang bral ba ni/ rdo rje gdan du 'gro ba la dpal thang sogs mig btsums pas chog pa yod de/ der yang 'jigs zon dgos/ ka ne 'go dang / bse zur bya ba mi bde yang zab ste phyin pas thar bas lam yin gyi gzhan nas 'gro sa med/ de bzhin du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar 'gro ba la/ skyon can brgyad sogs kyang lam skyon med kyang lam yin te/ dang po la'ang 'jigs mi dgos gegs bsal tshul yod/ gnyis pa la nga rgyal mi dgos/ de'i 'phro la skyon can skye srid pas thams cad byung rgyal du bskyangs pas sangs rgyas gsungs/ stong pa dang po 'di byung na shin tu 'jigs pa zhig 'ong ste/ bar sdings su sku gnyer zhig spos 'debs 'phro la nga gdan 'dug go zer/ de lta bu'i nyams byung na bla ma la phyag brjed 'gro bas/ de dran pa la spyi bor 'khor lo sogs kyi don bsams/ rtsa'i mtshan nyid chos rje ba nyams myong la sbyor te/

phra ba ni dbang las skyes pa'i ye shes/ sgra dang rtags sogs kyis mi rtogs pa/ des tha mal gyi sred pa dang rnam rtog 'bigs shing gcod pas rno zhing gcod pa/ bdag rgyud la zag med kyi ye shes bskyed pas 'jam zhes so/ /lus ngag yid rdo rje skyil dkrung ni nang gi skyil krung ste/ rdo rje'i skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /chog shes pa'i sogs khongs su thos bsam gyis chog pa'am/ yang na chog mi shes pa'ang bsdu ste de bas kyang zab pa 'dod pa sogs mang po nyan/ dbu mar log pa la/ gang du gang tshul ji ltar log gsum/ dang po ni dbu mar/ gnyis pa ni kun gzhi/ gsum pa rtog med du 'phos pa'i tshul gyis log gsungs/ ngo bo rang bzhin/ mtshan nyid la yi ge log na'o/ /'jig rten pa'i lam mo/ /de las 'das pa la rten dang / brten pa gnyis/ dang po la bzhi las/ rtsa 'jig rten las 'das pa ni dbu ma'i mdud pa dang po grol ba/ yi ge a li bcu gnyis las a thung gi stobs grub/ khams dwangs mas gsang gnas kyi phyed man chad brtan/ rlung 'das pa ni/ las rlung stong brgyad brgya ba zhig dbu mar thim ste zag med kyi'o/ /brten pa 'das pa ni zag med kyi bde stong mthong lam mo/ /gzhan des 'gre /'di man chad kyi gzhung don la rgyu bstan pa sogs bzhi'i go rim dang mthun par gzhung dkrugs nas mdzad do/ /rgyu la thog mar ring rgyu/ de'ang lus 'dag pa bum dbang zer yang mtshon pa tsam yin gyi gcig pus sprul sku thob mi nus bzhi ka dgos/ nye rgyu'i sprul sku las dbang bzhi bzhi zer ba ni khug pa bcu drug len pa ste/ de'i don bum dbang gtsor lus la bskur/ des yi ge dngos su lus la gnad du 'gro/ de la bum dbang gi bum dbang ngo / /shugs la yi ge la gnad du 'gro ste/ de la bum dbang gi gsang dbang zer/ des 'gre'o/ /khams/ rlung la'ang don gyis bskur bar 'gro ste/

de rnams tshogs pa tshar gcig na yod pas so/ /des gong ma gsum 'gre'o/ /mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid de yin byas na/ gzhan kun de'i 'khos ka'am zer 'ong ste/ nges don yin chos rje pa gsungs/ g.yang za ba ni/ dper na mi gcig brag 'phrod mi bde ba cig na phar phyin nas/ phyir mig bltas pas da 'gril mi 'gro yang sngar gyi de dran pas 'jigs pa bzhin no/ /rgod bro ba ni/ 'dod yon la chags pa'i sems can la bltas pas/ da ltar gyi 'bu sbrang khyi lud la chags pa bzhin mthong ste thugs kyi bas pa lta bu'o/ /rang gzhan ngo mi shes pa'ang dran med min te/ rang 'dzin rtog gzhan gzung rtog ngo mi shes pa ni de gnyis kyi stong ba'o/ /lhan cig skyes par thig le gnas pa'i dpe de 'jig rten pa yin pas mthong lam gyi dper 'thad dam ce na/ 'thad de/ dper na khyi bzang po seṅge 'dra zer ba bzhin/ de bas lhag pa'i dpe ma rnyed pas so/ /dwangs mas brtan zhes pa'ang sog sbubs chus gang ba bzhin min/ dwangs ma la dbang thob pa zer/ lung sgo bstun gyi dbang du byas na/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba/ thun mong min pa ltar na gnas zer/ spang bya mthong spang 'gags shing / rten 'brel bcu gnyis las rga shi 'gag /sa dang po'o/ /'jig rten pa'i dus su sprul skus bsu nas zhal mthong / sa drug pa man chad du longs skus bsu nas zhal mthong lung sgo bstun dkyus na/ thun mong min pa'i nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang / nye zhing / tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho zer/ yi ge u man chad kyi stobs grub/ bum dbang gi'o/ /gsang dbang gi ring rgyu'i dbang dang lam gnyis thog mar bla ma las thob cing / lam dus su rang gi bsgom pa ste/ 'og ma'ang des 'gre /yang longs sku las dbang bzhi bzhi zhes pa ni/ zlos pa'i sgra'i sbyor ba ste/ gsang dbang gis gtso byas pa'i bcu drug len pa'o/ /gzhan des 'gre /chos spyi sogs ni/ yang na spyi phar phyin/ rang rdo thig go

/lte bar yi ge'i phyi mo sogs ni/ lus chags tshul gyi dbang byas na/ rlung gnas pa la brten nas lte ba'i a thung chags/ de las nang bskor brgyad/ de las phyi bskor ro/ /de'ang a las a li ka las ka li sogs 'byung ste bsam pas shes/ gsung rab bcu gnyis la thogs pa med sogs kyang 'dir ngo bo tsam la yang dgongs kyi mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa na'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni bhi mu shu ma ra'o/ /ro drug ni/ kha ba bska ba sogs so/ /chos rje pa a li yig 'bru sogs ni/ snying po'i a'i che ba brjod pa'am yang na a yi ge kun gyi srog tu gnas pa'am/ yang lus chags tshul dang bstun na lte ba'i a thung las yi ge gzhan rnams bskyed pas kun gyi mchog ces so/ /a lis stong pa/ ka lis snang ba mtshon pas don dam skye med las ston pas don chen yi ge dam pa'o/ /khong na zhes pa a yi ge kun gyi srog tu gnas pa ltar/ sna tshogs kyi snang ba 'di rnams rang gi ngo bo stong nyid du gnas pa'o/ /tshig tu brjod pa zhes pa ni/ as don gyi rnam dbye gang mi ston yang brjod pa kun gyi rgyu byed/ de ltar stong pas don gyi rnam dbye mi ston yang snang ba'i gong 'byed pa bzhin no/ /'khor bzhi'i rgya ni/ rgya gar skad du tsa tur maṇ+ḍal la mu tra/ bod skad du/ 'khor bzhi'i rgya yin gsungs te/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa la trai maṇ+ḍal la pa ri shud+dha zer ba bzhin no/ /des na 'khor bzhi'i rgya ni/ don la dkyil 'khor bzhi'i rgya yin gsungs te/ ma dag pa rgyu rgyud sogs kyus na/ dge bshes dmar gyis 'khor lo phyed dang bdun dang / mdud pa phyed dang gsum dang / mdud pa gong ma'i cha grol ba sogs mi 'thad de/ tshig rkang dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro gsungs/ des na 'khor lo drug yin/ zhing khams rtsi ba dkyus dang / ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i ni mdud pa la rtsi ba dang / gnyis ka la gtsug tor mchog grub pa rtsi'o/

/dag pa ye shes kyi snang ba ni/ chos rje pa/ zhing khams kyi tshad cig byung phyin chad gzugs sku gnyis la rtsi'o/ /gzhan gnyis la mi rtsi gsungs/ sa dgu pa la ther 'bum/ bcu pa la ther 'bum chen po zer/ yi ge o man chad kyi stobs grub/ lung sgo bstun dkyus na/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ 'du ba dang / nye ba'i 'du ba/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ gsang dbang gi'o/ /chos sku las dbang bzhi bzhi zer yang / dbang bzhi sogs kyi go rim mi 'khrugs pa'i phyir yin gyi/ ngo bo chos sku la rnam pa longs sku las tha dad med gsungs/ sku gsum gyi dbang gi skabs su/ dang po gol na 'dod khams sogs rim pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa la gol sa med gsungs/ so sor rtog pa ni brten pa la brtsis na kun rdzob rgyu 'bras kyi cha so sor ma 'dres par rtogs pa la sbyor/ gdul bya'i don 'bad med du grub pas bya grub bo/ /gzhan go sla/ yid chos nyid kyi he ru ka zer/ aṃ ā zhes pa'i stobs grub/ sgom lam sa bcu gnyis pa'o zer te/ lung sgo bstun rgyu med pas sa bcu gnyis kyis chog gsungs/ thun mong min pa'i 'thung gcod/ nye ba'i 'thung gcod do/ /shes rab ye shes kyi'o/ /dbang blangs pa'i yul sku gsum tha mi dad zer yang rnam pa longs sku/ tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa ye shes lnga yin pa ni brten pa sems la rtsi/ rten la rtsi na ye shes lnga sogs kyang sku bzhi yin te/ de'ang snying kha na sbas pa'i rtsa lnga yod de gnas gyur sprul sku/ de bzhin du bh+rum̐ sogs yi ge lnga longs sku/ de rnams kyi nang gi dwangs ma chos sku/ de rnams dang tshogs pa gcig pa'i 'byung ba lnga'i rlung gnas gyur pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o/ /sa chen sogs ni thun mong gi theg pa las dpe gsungs te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gdan du sangs rgya ba na/ dga' rab dbang phyug sogs kyis dmag drangs pa na/ kho na re/

khyod sangs rgya ba'i rgyu ci yin zer/ der khyod mchod sbyin bag tsam byas pa'ang lhar skye na/ ngas grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pas ci'i phyir mi rgya gsungs pas/ nga'i dpang po khyod kyis 'ong ste/ khyod la su yod zer/ der phyag g.yas pa gser gyi mdog can sa la bzhag nas/ sa 'di rgyu dang mi rgyu kun gyi rten yin pas/ /de phyir brtan ma de ring bdag gi dpang mdzod cig /gsungs pa dpang byas lugs dkyus na/ mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlob pa ni/ chos rje pa rten 'brel gyi che bar 'dug de min na skad cig gnyis pa la sangs rgya ba la byin gyis brlob mi dgos te brlob/ da lta dgos te mi 'ong gsungs/ ha ri ma sogs ni dbang phyug gi don ldog brgyad dang ming bstun/ yang na sangs rgyas kyi rnam grangs yin gsungs/ bdud bzhi las rgyal zhes pa ni/ phar phyin pa bdud bzhi rim gyis spongs/ 'di pa cig car spong ste/ 'gros bzhi gcig char thim pas so/ /de'ang bdud bzhis dkyil 'khor bzhi la bar du gcod de/ phung po'i bdud kyis lus rtsa bar du gcod de phung po'i nying mtshams sbyor ba yin/ la/ lha'i bus yi ge yon tan skyer mi ster ba'o/ /la/ nyon mongs pas bdud rtsi la/ 'chi bdag gis rlung la bar du gcod do/ /des na rtsa'i 'gros thim pas phung po'i bdud las grol/ gzhan des 'gre /mjug bsdu cung sngas 'bras bu gcig gi dbang du byas te rab tu rgyas bshad tsho le tshar bas so/ /gsungs/ dge bshes dmar gyis sa brgyad pa nas nyer rgyu bsgom zer ba de/ de nas bsgom du rung mod/ 'dir sa bcu gnyis pa'i skabs yin pas gzhung dang 'gal bla chen pa gsungs zer te/ khong la sa dang po nas nye rgyu bsgom pa'i log rtog mi mnga'/ sa dang po ba yin na rten yang sa dang po gsungs mod lam dus su bsgom pa'i rten la dgongs zhes bla ma snyag gsungs/ 'khor tshom bu ni chos spyi skad dang bstun na/

las ma byas pa dang 'phrad pa'i skyon 'ong zer te/ 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis nang gi rten 'brel thugs su chud pas nges don yin gsungs/ de'ang gsol 'debs yul bla ma mang po dang / bdag la 'debs pa'i slob ma mang po/ bar chad bsrung ba'i chos skyong yang lhan cig skyes pa'i lha ste/ nyung na re re bsod nams can la mang po'ang yod pas de rnams dang / bdag gi grogs byed pa'i rten cig de rnams sangs rgya/ 'di la mtshams bzung ba yin gsungs/ rtogs nas rtags sogs ni/ bskyed rim la sbyar na rtogs pa rtags ni lha'i zhal phyag sogs sna tshogs la sems 'dzin pa/ rtog med ni snang stong zung 'jug lta bu skye ba'o/ /rdzogs rim la sbyar na dang pos lus kyi 'khrul 'khor/ rlung gi 'dren tshul/ sems kyi dmigs pa 'bar 'dzag la sogs la sems 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni gsal stong gi nyams skye ba la bya ste/ dper na chu 'dod pa la sa brkos pas 'ong ba'am/ gyang brkos pas nam mkha' 'ong ba dang 'dra ste/ 'dir las 'bras kyi gnad thams cad bsdus nas bstan pa lta bu gcig yin gsungs/ lam zab bla ma'i skabs su/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong ba'ang 'dir ston/ dper na dpal ldan 'bras spungs pa bzhin te/ khong gis bsgoms/ nye gnas gcig gis 'tsho ba sbyangs pas/ rgya gar du lo gcig gnyis su char ma byung / mu ge chen po byung ste/ de'i stobs kyis nye gnas bla ma'i drung du 'gyel/ ci yin byas pas/ sngar bla ma'i thugs dam la gnod snyam gsang pa lags/ char med pas mu ge byung / de'i rgyu mtshan lags byas pas/ 'o na snga mo mi zer ba thabs yod pas gsungs/ da bla mas 'bras kyi char 'bebs pa yod pas ci 'dra dgos zhes dri sgrogs gsungs nas bsgrags pas/ blo chung pa 'ga' zhig 'bras btsos pa'i zer/ 'ga' zhig de rul 'gro bas brus pa'i zer/ de'ang rul 'gro bas so ba'i phob zer/ phab pas gyang rim bdun bdun tsam babs te/

mu ge las grol bar byas/ de lta bu'i nus pa mnga' ba'i bla ma bas kyang / nye gnas kyis zhabs tog byas pas ma bsgoms kyang nye gnas des bla ma bas lo bcu gnyis kyis grub pa thob pa snga bar byung gsungs/ 'bring dam tshig zer yang gsum ka gces so zhes gsungs so/ /de yan gyis gsung bgros zab mo rnams zhib tu bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ 'di sbyar dge ba'i bsod nams dpag med kyis/ /bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /rim gnyis zab mo'i don la rab zhugs te/ /sku bzhi'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas thob nas kyang / /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa du ma yi/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i 'phrin las bsam yas kyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rigs drug ma lus kun/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid la 'god par shog ces lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag zab mo 'chad cing nyams su len pa la nye bar mkho ba'i bla ma gong ma'i gsung bgros zab mo rnams bsgrigs pa'i bar ston zin bris su grags pa'i gsung rab nas shin tu zab pa'i gsung bgros kyi gnad rnams logs su bkol ba sgrub pa po rnams kyi yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni snga mo nas rtsom pa'i 'dun pas phal cher rdzogs par grub kyang / mjug cung zad ma rdzogs pa rnams dus phyis bskul ba sogs rkyen 'ga' zhig la brten nas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dang / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba mus pa chen rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan te yongs 'dzin 'gran zla dang bral ba du mas thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho zhing / stobs kyi mgon po dpal bi ru pas rjes su bzung ba'i theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis gsung ngag lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag nyams len pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i kun nas bslangs te/
